AdsPlatform.description: The platform returned when you last retrieved the campaign, ad group, or ad. A different current platform rejects the request with campaign_changed; retrieve the resource again before editing. Required after a delivery-platform migration when creating ads or ad groups, or changing fields other than title, status, budget, and account scope.
AdsPlatform.name: X-Ads-Platform

ApiVersionDate.description: Pins the request to a dated API version.
ApiVersionDate.name: Api-Version-Date

IdempotencyKey.description: A unique key that makes this request safe to retry. See [Idempotent requests](https://docs.whop.com/developer/api/idempotency).
IdempotencyKey.name: Idempotency-Key

AccessLevel.description: The access level a given user (or company) has to a product or company.

AccessPassOrder.description: The ways a relation of AccessPasses can be ordered

AccessPassTypes.description: The different types an product can be. Only use 'regular'. The rest are for internal use

AccessToken.description: A short-lived access token used to authenticate API requests on behalf of a user.

expires_at.description: The timestamp after which this access token is no longer valid and must be refreshed.

token.description: The signed JWT access token string to include in API request Authorization headers.

ads_spend_usd.description: Lifetime charged ad spend for the account, in USD. Computed only on `list` for callers with `stats:read` on the account; `null` otherwise.

items.description: Account holdings, each with USD value. Empty when `total_usd` is `null`.

business_address.description: Account business address used to calculate tax, with `line1`, `line2`, `city`, `state`, `postal_code`, and `country`. `null` when no address is set.

business_name.description: The account's legal business name used with its tax address.

business_type.description: High-level business category for the account. See the [business types and industries glossary](/api-reference/beta/accounts/account#business-types-and-industries-glossary) for valid values.

can_transfer_pending_balance_to_children.description: Whether pending funds may be transferred from this platform account to its connected accounts.

cancellation_policy.description: The account's cancellation policy document, or `null` if they have not published one.

capabilities.description: Payment rails enabled for this account, each `active`, `inactive`, or `pending` (onboarding or review in progress). Computed only on `retrieve` and `me` for callers with `company:balance:read` scope; `null` otherwise.

cards.description: Whop Cards application details for the account. Returned on `list`, `retrieve`, and `me` for callers with `company:balance:read` scope; `null` otherwise, or when the account has no card application or blocking application review.

collect_vat_id.description: Whether checkout shows a VAT/tax ID field for buyers to optionally enter. Does not require a VAT ID to purchase.

company_formation.description: Company formation state for the account, managed through [Form Company](/api-reference/beta/accounts/form-company). A `draft` `status` until the formation checkout is paid, then filing progress with downloadable documents and signatures awaiting action. Empty when the formation state is temporarily unavailable.

country.description: Country where the account is located.

created_at.description: When the account was created, as an ISO 8601 timestamp.

customers_l30d.description: Distinct customers with a paid receipt at the account in the last 30 days, refreshed every few hours. Computed only on `retrieve` for callers with `stats:read` on the account; `null` otherwise, and when the count is unavailable.

description.description: Account promotional description.
description.example: Mobile ceramic coating, paint correction, and interior detailing across the Austin metro.

direct_reports_count.description: How many team members report to the business directly, with no manager above them. Present on single-account reads.

dispute_fighter_enabled.description: Whether Whop assembles and files dispute evidence for this account. Enabling it opts the account into the success fee charged on disputes it wins.

economic_intelligence.description: Whether Economic Intelligence is on for the account. It turns off automatically when its committed period ends.

email.description: Account owner email address.

eula.description: The account's end-user license agreement document, or `null` if they have not published one.

financing.description: The account's most recent financing application. Computed only on `retrieve` and `me` for callers with `company:balance:read` scope; `null` otherwise, or when the account has never applied for financing.

items.description: Public account home page preferences.

id.description: Account ID, prefixed `biz_`.

industry_type.description: Specific industry vertical for the account. See the [business types and industries glossary](/api-reference/beta/accounts/account#business-types-and-industries-glossary) for valid values.

level.description: The Whop Levels progress of the account's `owner`, counted across every account they own, so all of them show the same level. Computed only on `retrieve` and `me` for callers with `company:basic:read` scope; `null` otherwise, and when the account is not in Whop Levels.

metadata.description: Arbitrary key/value metadata supplied at account creation.

onboarding_type.description: Type of onboarding the account has completed.

orchestration_enabled.description: Whether payment orchestration is enabled for this account.

other_business_description.description: Business type details when business_type is `other`.

owner.description: The single user who owns the account, whose email is the `email` above. Distinct from the `owner` role on team members, which any number of them can hold.

parent_account.description: Parent account for connected accounts, or `null` for standalone accounts.

partner.description: The account's active first-tier partner. Present on retrieve responses; null when no active first-tier partner is attributed to the account. Omitted from other responses.

payment_controls.description: Payment health controls currently applied to the account. Computed only on `retrieve` and `me` for callers with `company:balance:read` scope; `null` otherwise.

items.description: Whop-issued platform credits per currency, read from the balance cache. Credits can only be spent on eligible Whop products such as Whop Ads, can never be withdrawn, and are not included in `balances` or `total_usd`. Empty when the account holds none or `total_usd` is `null`.

privacy_policy.description: The account's privacy policy document, or `null` if they have not published one.

product_tax_code.description: Tax classification code applied by default to the account's products, with `id`, `name`, and `product_type`. `null` when no default is set.

items.description: Deprecated: use the `GET /economic_intelligence?account_id={account_id}` endpoint instead. Optional actions that unlock capabilities or grow the account, same shape as `required_actions`. Computed only on `retrieve` and `me`; `null` otherwise.

require_2fa.description: Whether authorized users must enable two-factor authentication.

items.description: Actions the account owner must take to unblock capabilities like payouts and card spend, ordered by display priority. Computed only on `retrieve` and `me` for callers with `company:balance:read` scope; `null` otherwise.

return_policy.description: The account's return policy document, or `null` if they have not published one.

items.description: Business rewards attached through this account's active referral link, with account-specific progress and ledger status. Present on retrieve responses; empty without both balance and stats read access.

route.description: Account public route identifier.

send_customer_emails.description: Whether Whop sends transactional emails to customers on behalf of this account.

shipping_policy.description: The account's shipping policy document, or `null` if they have not published one.

show_joined_whops.description: Whether the account appears in joined whops on other accounts.

show_reviews_dtc.description: Whether reviews are displayed on direct-to-consumer product pages.

show_user_directory.description: Whether the account shows users in the user directory.

items.description: Account social links.

status.description: Whether the account can operate on Whop: `active` or `suspended`. Computed on `list`, `retrieve`, `me`, and `suspend`; `null` otherwise.

status_reason.description: Why the account was suspended, as the label shown to the account owner, such as `Suspended - Fraudulent activity`. Computed on `retrieve`, `me`, and `suspend`; `null` otherwise, when `status` is not `suspended`, and when the suspension was recorded without a reason.

target_audience.example: Owners of new and enthusiast vehicles in Austin, TX

items.description: US state codes (of the 50 states plus `DC`) where the account collects tax: the full set when Whop remits (`tax_remitted_by` `whop`), the configured subset when the account self-remits (`self`), and empty when neither. On update, send the complete list to replace it (only allowed when `self`).
Account tax/VAT registrations. Empty when none are set.

tax_remitted_by.description: Who calculates and remits tax for the account: `whop` (Whop calculates and remits), `self` (Whop calculates; the account collects and remits), or `none` (neither; the account is responsible). `null` until the account enrolls in the Whop tax service.

tax_type.description: How tax is applied to the account's prices: `inclusive` (tax included in the listed price) or `exclusive` (tax added on top). Defaults to `exclusive` when unset; `null` only when the account has no payment connection.

terms_of_service.description: The account's terms of service document, or `null` if they have not published one.

three_ds_level.description: 3D Secure behavior for supported on-session card payments. `mandate_challenge` requires a 3DS challenge before payment processing; `mandate_if_required` mandates a challenge only when the payment processor requires it; `frictionless_if_required` uses the regular frictionless 3DS flow. Payments of $1,000 or more use `mandate_if_required` unless `mandate_challenge` is selected. Risk and authentication recovery requirements can override the preference. `null` uses the standard checkout flow.

title.description: Account display name.

total_earned_usd.description: Account lifetime sales, normalized to USD. Computed only on `retrieve` and `me` for callers with `stats:read` scope; `null` otherwise.

total_usd.description: Total USD value across balances with known exchange rates. Computed only on single-account reads (`retrieve` and `me`); `null` on list responses, writes, missing balance-read permission, or unavailable balance source.

trading.description: The trading account address and its WebSocket subscriptions. Opt in with `include_trading=true` on single-account reads. `null` otherwise, without trading permission, or without an Ethereum wallet.

use_logo_as_opengraph_image_fallback.description: Whether the account uses its logo as the fallback Open Graph image.

verification.description: Account identity verification status for the `individual` (KYC) and `business` (KYB) profiles. Each is `null` until created, otherwise a `status` of `not_started`, `pending`, `manual_review`, `approved`, or `rejected`.

volume_l30d_usd.description: Volume through the account in the last 30 days (GMV from paid receipts), normalized to USD. Computed only on `list` for callers with `stats:read` on the account; `null` otherwise.

volume_usd.description: Lifetime volume through the account — sales plus transfers received — normalized to USD. Computed only on `list` for callers with `stats:read` on the account; `null` otherwise.

wallet.description: Account primary crypto wallet, or `null` if none has been provisioned.

website.description: The account's business website URL, or `null` if none has been provided. Setting it also adds a `website` entry to `social_links`.

whop_partner_enabled_at.description: When the account turned on Whop Partner mode, as an ISO 8601 timestamp. Present on single-account reads and update responses; `null` until the account turns Whop Partner mode on by sending `whop_partner_enabled: true` on update.

available.description: Amount you can spend, send, or withdraw now, in native units, as a decimal string.

finishing_settlement.description: The part of `pending` that has already settled and is waiting to move into the account's crypto wallet or Whop Card, where it becomes `available`. The move usually starts within the hour; while it runs, the amount is reported in `in_transit` instead. Money moved only to top up the account's retained minimum balance is not included. In native units, as a decimal string.

in_transit.description: Amount moving between the account's own destinations, such as a card top-up. In native units, as a decimal string.

pending.description: Amount from recent payments still settling, in native units, as a decimal string.

items.description: When the pending amount is expected to settle, one entry per day, earliest first. Money without a scheduled settlement day, including `finishing_settlement`, is left out, so these entries plus `finishing_settlement` can sum to less than `pending`, never more.

reserve.description: Amount held back, in native units, as a decimal string. Retrieve the account's reserves for why it is held and when it unlocks.

amount.description: Amount expected that day, in native units, as a decimal string.

date.description: The day this money is expected to finish settling, as an ISO 8601 date.

balance.description: Total amount held in native units, as a decimal string.

breakdown.description: Balance split into available, pending, and reserve amounts, as native-unit decimal strings, with the days the pending amount is expected to settle.

name.description: The holding's display name

price_usd.description: USD price per unit, or `null` when no exchange rate is available.

symbol.description: Holding display symbol, such as `USDT`, `cbBTC`, or `EUR`.

value_usd.description: Holding USD value, or `null` when no exchange rate is available.

accept_bank_payments.description: Bank payins: debits, transfers, and local bank rails

accept_card_payments.description: Card payins, including Apple Pay and Google Pay

bank_deposit.description: Deposits by bank wire or ACH to the account's virtual bank account

card_deposit.description: Balance top-ups by charging a stored payment method

card_issuing.description: Issuing Whop cards; requires card application approval

crypto_deposit.description: On-chain deposits to the account's crypto wallet

crypto_payout.description: On-chain payouts to a crypto wallet

instant_payout.description: Instant payouts to an eligible payout destination

run_ads.description: Launching ad campaigns through Whop Ads. `inactive` until the account's identity or business is verified, and while a requested ads services agreement is awaiting the account's signature.

standard_payout.description: Standard payouts to an external payout destination

kind.description: Whether the card application verifies a business (`business`, KYB) or a person (`individual`, consumer identity). `null` when the application is not yet linked to a verification.

status.description: Where the card application stands. `approved` means cards can be issued. `needs_verification` means the applicant has not completed identity verification yet; `needs_information` means they did, but the documents were rejected for a fixable reason and must be resubmitted. `pending` and `manual_review` are in flight. `denied`, `locked`, and `canceled` are terminal.

items.description: Formation documents available for download, such as the Articles of Organization and the EIN confirmation letter. Present once `status` leaves `draft`.

ein_registered.description: Whether the company's EIN has been issued by the IRS. Present once `status` leaves `draft`.

legal_name.description: Registered company name including the entity ending, for example `Acme, LLC`. Present once `status` leaves `draft`.

signatures.description: IRS forms still awaiting a founder's signature, each with a hosted signing URL. Present once `status` leaves `draft`; empty when nothing needs signing.

state_registered.description: Whether the state formation filing is complete. Present once `status` leaves `draft`.

id.description: Document ID, prefixed `file_`.

name.description: Human-readable document name, such as `Articles of Organization`.

type.description: Document category: `articles_of_organization`, `operating_agreement`, `ein_letter`, `signed_ss4`, `signed_form8821`, or `mail` for postal correspondence received on the company's behalf.

url.description: CDN URL for downloading the document.

expires_at.description: When the signing URL expires, as an ISO 8601 timestamp. Present only when the signing URL is included.

status.description: `pending` when a signing session is ready for the founder; `unknown` when the signature state could not be determined.

url.description: Hosted signing URL where the founder completes the form. Present while `status` is `pending` and the caller has `incorporation:write`. Omitted from webhooks.

form8821.description: Signature state for IRS Form 8821, the tax information authorization. Present only while the form still needs the founder's action.

ss4.description: Signature state for IRS Form SS-4, the EIN application. Present only while the form still needs the founder's action.

all.description: Whether this account pays payout fees for all of its connected accounts' payout methods. Turning this off clears category coverage.

bank_wire.description: Whether this account covers its connected accounts' bank wire payout fees. Individual changes have no effect while `all` is true.

crypto.description: Whether this account covers its connected accounts' crypto payout fees. Individual changes have no effect while `all` is true.

digital_wallet.description: Whether this account covers its connected accounts' digital wallet payout fees. Individual changes have no effect while `all` is true.

next_day_bank.description: Whether this account covers its connected accounts' next day bank payout fees. Individual changes have no effect while `all` is true.

rtp.description: Whether this account covers its connected accounts' real-time payment payout fees. Individual changes have no effect while `all` is true.

accent_color.description: Accent color, as a `#rrggbb` hex color.

business_name.description: The business name shown on its customer tracking page.

button_text_color.description: `black` or `white`, whichever reads against the accent color.

logo_url.description: The account logo image URL, or `null` when it has not uploaded one.

show_business_name.description: Whether to display the business name on the tracking page and Element.

show_logo.description: Whether to display the logo on the tracking page and Element.

support_email.description: Customer support email address, or `null` when not set.

support_url.description: HTTPS customer support URL, or `null` when not set.

locked.description: Whether the account owner is prevented from changing this threshold.

threshold_usd.description: Maximum dispute alert amount automatically refunded in USD. `null` when automatic refunds are disabled.

auto_renew.description: Whether this offer renews every period until auto-renew is turned off, rather than ending after one.

duration.description: What period of time Economic Intelligence stays on. For an auto-renew offer, the length of each period it renews for.

duration_unit.description: The unit of time the duration is in (hours or days)

fee_percentage.description: Percentage of volume charged while Economic Intelligence is on, such as `1.5` for 1.5%.

key.description: The unique identifier for this offer. Pass this value as `economic_intelligence_duration_key` to turn it on.

recommended.description: Whether Whop recommends this offer. At most one offer is recommended.

ended_at.description: When the period ended, as an ISO 8601 timestamp.

fee_percentage.description: Percentage of volume charged during the period, such as `3` for 3%.

adjustable.description: Whether the caller may change this fee through `PATCH`. Depends on who is asking.

category.description: Which group of the fee schedule this fee belongs to, for grouping in a UI.

default.description: The platform rate before custom or inherited pricing is applied. Its `percentage` and `fixed` are `null` when a connected account's fees are read without access to its parent account.

ends_at.description: When a custom or inherited rate expires and the fee returns to `default`, as an ISO 8601 timestamp. `null` when the default applies, the rate does not expire, or a connected account's fees are read without access to its parent account.

fixed.description: The amount charged per event in effect. `null` when the fee has no fixed component.

maximum.description: The highest rate the caller may set. `null` when the fee is not adjustable or the caller is not capped.

minimum.description: The lowest rate the caller may set, present only when `adjustable`.

percentage.description: The percentage of the transaction in effect, where `2` means 2%. `null` when the fee has no percentage component.

region.description: The acquirer region `percentage` and `fixed` describe, for a fee that varies by where the money is processed. `null` for a fee that does not vary by region.

regions.description: The rate, source, default, reset rate, and editable limits in every other region this fee varies by, keyed by region. Empty for a fee that does not vary by region.

reset.description: The rate that takes effect when this account's custom rate is cleared, including inherited pricing. Its `percentage` and `fixed` are `null` when a connected account's fees are read without access to its parent account.

source.description: Where the rate in effect comes from: `default` is the platform rate, `custom` a rate negotiated for this account, and `inherited` a rate negotiated by the platform this account is connected to. `null` when a connected account's fees are read without access to its parent account.

unadjustable_reason.description: Why the caller may not change this fee, or `null` when `adjustable`. `not_permitted` when the caller has no say over it.

adjustable.description: Whether the caller may change this markup through `PATCH`. True for the platform's team holding the `company:update_child_fees` scope.

default.description: What applies if this row is cleared: the platform's default for all its connected accounts, or zero. Its `percentage` and `fixed` are `null` when a connected account's fees are read without access to its parent account.

fixed.description: The amount the platform adds per event. Zero when no markup is set.

maximum.description: The highest markup the platform may set.

percentage.description: The percentage of the transaction the platform adds, where `2` means 2%. `0` when no markup is set.

source.description: `custom` when a row is set at this level, `default` when the rate falls through to the platform default or zero. `null` when a connected account's fees are read without access to its parent account.

unadjustable_reason.description: Why the caller may not change this markup, or `null` when `adjustable`.

card_spend.description: The markup on card purchases settled by the connected account.

crypto_swaps.description: The markup on cryptocurrency token swaps.

deposits.description: Markups on deposits into the account's balance, keyed by rail: `bank` and `crypto`.

payments.description: The markup on payments the connected account collects without a checkout application fee.

payouts.description: Markups on withdrawals, keyed by payout method: `bank_wire`, `next_day_bank`, `rtp`, `crypto`, and `digital_wallet`.

transfers.description: The markup on transfers between Whop balances.

fixed.description: The amount charged per event. `null` when unavailable.

percentage.description: The percentage of the transaction, where `2` means 2%. `null` when unavailable.

default.description: The platform rate for this region before custom or inherited pricing is applied.

fixed.description: The amount charged per event in effect. `null` when the fee has no fixed component.

maximum.description: The highest regional rate the caller may set. `null` when the fee is not adjustable or the caller is not capped.

minimum.description: The lowest regional rate the caller may set, present only when the fee is adjustable.

percentage.description: The percentage of the transaction in effect, where `2` means 2%. `null` when the fee has no percentage component.

reset.description: The regional rate that takes effect when this account's custom rate is cleared, including inherited pricing.

source.description: Where the regional rate in effect comes from: `default` is the platform rate, `custom` a rate negotiated for this account, and `inherited` a rate negotiated by the platform this account is connected to.

account_id.description: The account these fees are charged to, prefixed `biz_`.

ach_dispute.description: Charged when the account holder disputes an ACH payment.

ach_return.description: Charged when an ACH payment is returned by the buyer's bank.

bank_deposit.description: Charged on bank deposits into the account's balance.

buyer.description: Charged to the buyer at checkout, on top of the price.

card_processing.description: Card payments. `percentage` and `fixed` are the rate in the headline `region`; every other acquirer region is under `regions`.

child_markups.description: The default markups this account charges connected accounts, configurable before any accounts connect. `null` if this account has a parent.

covered_payout_fees.description: Which payout fees this account pays for its connected accounts.

cross_border.description: Added to a payment whose card was issued outside the region where the payment was processed.

dispute.description: Charged when a payment is disputed.

dispute_alert.description: Charged when an early dispute alert lets Whop refund a payment before it becomes a dispute.

dispute_alert_cdrn.description: The early dispute alert fee when the alert comes through Verifi CDRN.

dispute_alert_ethoca.description: The early dispute alert fee when the alert comes through Ethoca.

dispute_alert_rdr.description: The early dispute alert fee when the alert comes through Verifi RDR.

dispute_representment.description: Charged on the amount recovered when Whop fights a dispute and wins.

foreign_exchange.description: Added to a payment settled in a currency other than the one it was charged in.

fraud_screening.description: Charged when a payment is screened for fraud.

high_risk.description: Added to every payment while the account is classed as high risk.

marketplace.description: Charged on payments attributed to the Whop marketplace.

markups.description: What the platform this account is connected to adds on top of Whop's fees, collected by that platform. `null` unless the account has a parent.

orchestration.description: Charged on payments routed through Whop's payment orchestration.

parent_account_id.description: The platform this account is connected to, whose markups appear under `markups`. `null` for a standalone account.

payment_methods.description: Processing fees for every non-card payment method the platform prices, keyed by payment method type such as `us_bank_account` or `klarna`.

payouts.description: Fees on withdrawals, keyed by payout method: `bank_wire`, `same_day_bank`, `next_day_bank`, `rtp`, `crypto`, and `digital_wallet`. Payout fees the parent account covers show as zero when a connected account's fees are read without access to its parent account.

pending_auto_topup.description: Charged when pending, not-yet-settled balance is advanced to fund the account's cards balance.

platform_processing.description: Whop's share of every payment, on top of card processing.

pool_payout.description: Charged on payouts from a shared pool balance.

revshare.description: Charged on payments where the account shares revenue with revshare affiliates.

sepa_dispute.description: Charged when the account holder disputes a SEPA Direct Debit payment.

sepa_return.description: Charged when a SEPA Direct Debit payment is returned by the buyer's bank.

tax_calculation.description: Charged when tax is calculated on a payment.

tax_service.description: Charged when Whop collects and remits tax on the account's behalf.

three_ds.description: Charged when a payment is authenticated with 3-D Secure.

transfers.description: Charged on transfers from the account's balance to another Whop balance.

application_id.description: The ID of the account's most recent financing application, starting with inrq_. Retrieve it for requirements and review feedback.

status.description: The most recent financing application's review state: `requires_collection` (waiting on the merchant, including after a request for more information), `awaiting_review`, `approved`, `denied`, or `completed`. Whether financing payment methods are enabled is `capabilities.accept_bnpl_payments`.

boosted.description: `true` when this account's own points this month fall short of `current`, so the owner's other accounts lift it to this level.

current.description: Current level, from `0` before the first threshold up to `10`.

points.description: Points earned this month across every account the owner owns.

points_by_source.description: This month's points, split by where they were earned.

points_to_next.description: Points still needed this month to reach the next level, or `null` at level `10`.

resets_at.description: When this month's points reset to zero, as an ISO 8601 timestamp.

AccountLink.description: A temporary, time-limited URL that grants a user access to an external account management page.

expires_at.description: The timestamp after which this account link URL is no longer valid.

url.description: The temporary URL to redirect the user to for account access. Expires at the time specified by expires_at.

AccountLinkUseCases.description: The different use cases for generating an account link.

fixed_fee_usd.description: Fixed markup in US dollars per transaction.

percentage_fee.description: Percentage of the transaction charged as markup.

fees.description: Markup rates this parent charges the connected account being read, keyed by fee type (for example `crypto_deposit_markup`), each with `percentage_fee` and `fixed_fee_usd`. Resolved with the connected account's own overrides winning over the platform default.

id.description: Account ID, prefixed `biz_`.

route.description: Account public route identifier.

title.description: Account display name.

email.description: Email address for contacting the partner. Null when the partner has not added their own email address.

id.description: User ID, prefixed `user_`.

name.description: Display name.

profile_picture.description: Avatar wrapper; its `url` is always present, using a generated placeholder when the user set no picture.

username.description: Public username.

whop_partner_verified_at.description: When the user became a verified Whop Partner, as an ISO 8601 timestamp. Null if not verified.

id.description: Reward definition ID, prefixed `prwd_`. Progress and status apply to the containing account.

qualification_amount.description: Qualifying USD volume required to earn this reward.

qualification_progress.description: Qualifying USD volume for the reward’s activity accumulated by this account since attribution, calculated using the fulfillment rules.

qualification_type.description: Activity that qualifies this account for the reward.

reward_amount.description: USD amount credited for this reward. Uses the saved grant amount once fulfillment has started.

status.description: This account's reward state. Credited requires a posted ledger entry; processing includes a met requirement awaiting fulfillment. Reversing and reversed reflect a subsequent reward reversal.

dispute_alert_auto_refund.description: Automatic refund settings for pre-chargeback dispute alerts.

dispute_alert_fee_usd.description: Fee charged for each dispute alert in USD. `null` when unavailable.

enforce_3ds.description: Whether 3-D Secure is forced on every card payment at checkout. The account cannot bypass it while set.

financing_disabled.description: Whether payment health controls explicitly disable financing. This is independent of financing approval in `capabilities.accept_bnpl_payments`.

high_risk_processing_fee_percentage.description: Additional processing fee percentage for high-risk processing.

pending_auto_topup_fee_percentage.description: Percentage fee charged when pending, not-yet-settled balance is advanced to fund the account's cards balance, where `2` means 2%. `0` when the account is exempt.

pending_balance_delay_days.description: Additional days payments remain pending before becoming available.

reserve.description: Reserve currently applied to incoming payment volume.

resolution_center_auto_refund.description: Automatic refund settings for resolution center cases.

items.description: Card brands blocked at checkout for this account. Empty when none are blocked. The account cannot re-enable them itself.

undated_pending_reason.description: Why pending funds without a settlement date aren't moving yet. `kyc_incomplete`, `pending_information_request`, and `update_payout_profile` are things the merchant can act on. `compliance_review` means a verification the merchant already submitted is being reviewed, so these funds stay pending until it clears. `withdrawals_disabled` means Whop has blocked withdrawals, so these funds cannot become available. `null` when there's no reason to show — still clearing, or held for a reason that isn't named here.

withdrawal_schedule.description: How the account's balance automatically withdraws.

ads_agreement.description: The account's Whop Ads services and payment authorization agreement. `status` is `not_required`, `pending_signature` (a signature has been requested and campaign launch is blocked until it is provided), or `signed`. While pending, read the fields to answer from `GET /verifications/{id}` and sign by submitting them via `PATCH /verifications/{id}`.

items.description: The account's advertising certifications, one entry per certification type Whop offers. `status` is `not_started`, `pending_information` (an application is open and waiting for answers), `in_review`, `approved`, or `denied`. Start an application by setting a type's `status` to `pending_information` here, then answer the fields it requests via `GET`/`PATCH /verifications/{id}`; `approved_countries` is where approved certifications of that type let the account run ads.

ads_payment_methods.description: How the account pays for Whop Ads spend. `primary` is charged first; `backup` covers the charge when it fails. Each entry has a `type` of `platform_balance` (id `ldgr_`) or `card` (id `payt_`), plus display fields so the configured source renders even for a viewer who doesn't own it. `backup` is `null` when only one method is configured. `null` until ads billing has been configured.

ads_reporting_currency.description: Lowercase ISO currency code, such as `usd` or `eur`, used to display ad spend and stats. Defaults to `usd`.

ads_scheduling_timezone.description: IANA timezone (e.g. `America/New_York`) used to interpret campaign start/end times and to bucket reports. Defaults to `America/New_York` until explicitly overridden.

ads_triple_whale_integration.description: The account's Triple Whale integration, which pushes Whop ad spend to Triple Whale's Data-In API so it reports as a `whop` channel, and tags ad click-through URLs with `tw_source`/`tw_adid` so Triple Whale's pixel attributes conversions back to the right ad. `status` is `connected`, `not_connected`, or `requires_shop_domain` (Triple Whale keys records by shop, so spend only flows once `shop_domain` is set). `masked_api_key` shows the leading characters of the stored key; the full key is never returned. `shop_domain` is the shop spend is reported for.

cards_auto_top_up.description: Whether incoming funds are automatically moved to the account's cards balance. `false` when the account has no cards balance.

cards_notifications.description: Whether Whop Card notifications reach this account's team. `true` by default, including when the account has no cards balance. Set it to `false` to stop every card email and push notification for the account — application status, verification and action-required alerts, card-ready alerts, declines, large charges, and cashback summaries. Cardholder onboarding invitations still send, because they carry the only link an invited cardholder can onboard with. Requesting a card is rejected while notifications are off, since the request reaches nobody. Cards on personal accounts are unaffected.

covers_connected_account_negative_balanc.description: Whether this account covers its connected accounts' negative balances. When a connected account's balance drops below zero (from refunds, disputes, or fees), this account's available balance in the same currency pays it back, up to what is available. Refunds on its connected accounts may also take them negative by up to this account's available balance. `null` when the account has no connected accounts.

customer_tracking.description: The saved customer tracking settings for the hosted tracking page and Element, exactly as saved. `null` until set; tracking is off unless `enabled` is `true`.

dispute_fighter_enabled.description: Whether Whop assembles and files the evidence response when this account's payments are disputed. Off by default; enabling it also opts the account into the success fee charged only on disputes it wins.

economic_intelligence.description: Whether Economic Intelligence is on for the account. It turns off automatically at `economic_intelligence_ends_at`.

economic_intelligence_auto_renew.description: Whether Economic Intelligence renews itself every week, with no end date. Turn it on with the `weekly` offer. Set it to `false` to stop renewing, which keeps Economic Intelligence on until the end of the current week, shown in `economic_intelligence_ends_at`; stopping before the first renewal charges the rest of that week at the `7_days` offer's fee. Set it back to `true` before then to keep renewing at the weekly fee.

economic_intelligence_ends_at.description: When the account's committed Economic Intelligence period ends, as an ISO 8601 timestamp. Economic Intelligence can't be turned off before then. `null` when Economic Intelligence is off or renews automatically.

economic_intelligence_fee_percentage.description: Percentage of volume charged while Economic Intelligence is on, such as `1.5` for 1.5%. `null` when Economic Intelligence is off.

economic_intelligence_first_renewal_at.description: When auto-renew first renews, as an ISO 8601 timestamp. Turning auto-renew off before then charges the rest of that week at the `7_days` offer's fee. `null` when auto-renew is off.

items.description: What the account can choose now to turn on Economic Intelligence, each with its fee. Every offer while Economic Intelligence is off; only the `weekly` auto-renew offer while a committed period is running, as an upgrade; empty while it renews automatically.

economic_intelligence_previous_period.description: The account's last Economic Intelligence period, once it has ended. `null` while Economic Intelligence is on, or when it has never been on.

items.description: The account's own cancel reasons, in the order members see them when they cancel. Each is filed under a standard category, saved as the membership's `cancel_option`, so reports keep grouping cancellations. Empty when the account uses Whop's default reasons.

preferred_settlement_currency.description: Lowercase ISO currency code every new sale settles into, regardless of the plan's currency or what the buyer paid in. Sales converted this way carry an additional 0.5% FX fee. `null` when the account settles each sale in its plan's currency.

preferred_settlement_currency_changeable.description: When `preferred_settlement_currency` may next be changed or turned off, as an ISO 8601 timestamp. It can change at most once a day. `null` when it may change now.

subscription_failure_behavior.description: What happens to a subscription once every retry of a renewal payment has failed. `cancel` (the default) cancels it. `none` leaves it past due and keeps billing it each period; access follows the account's past-due access setting.

amount.description: Total held in this currency, in native units, as a decimal string. All dollar holdings are reported as one `usd` entry, matching how the balance row groups them.

items.description: The total split by why each part is held. Only reasons holding a non-zero amount appear, so these can sum to less than `amount`, never more.

currency.description: Lowercase ISO currency code, such as `usd` or `eur`.

items.description: When the held money unlocks, one entry per day, earliest first. Money whose release depends on something other than a date is left out, so these can sum to less than `amount`, never more.

hold_period_days.description: Number of days reserved funds are held before release.

percentage.description: Percentage of incoming payment volume held in reserve. `null` when no reserve is applied.

amount.description: Amount held for this reason, in native units, as a decimal string.

hold_period_days.description: Days money is currently held for this reason before it unlocks, or `null` when release depends on something other than time. Money already held keeps the terms it was taken under.

percentage.description: Percentage of each incoming payment currently held for this reason, or `null` when the reason is not a percentage of anything. Money already held keeps the release date it was given, which `unlocks_by_date` reflects.

type.description: Why this part of the balance is held. `regular` is the account's standing risk reserve; `bnpl` and `sequra` cover buy-now-pay-later settlement; `preshipment_hold` covers a physical order that has not shipped yet; `fraud_hold` is held while activity is reviewed.

amount.description: Amount unlocking that day across every reason, in native units, as a decimal string.

items.description: That day's amount split by why it is held. Only reasons unlocking a non-zero amount appear, so these can sum to less than `amount`, never more.

date.description: The day this money unlocks, as an ISO 8601 date.

amount.description: Amount unlocking that day for this reason, in native units, as a decimal string.

type.description: Why this part of the day's unlock is held, matching `type` on the reserve's `by_type`.

card_threshold_usd.description: Maximum card-funded resolution center case amount automatically refunded in USD. `null` when automatic refunds are disabled for cards.

financing_threshold_usd.description: Maximum financing-funded resolution center case amount automatically refunded in USD. `null` when automatic refunds are disabled for financing.

locked.description: Whether the account owner is prevented from changing these thresholds.

paypal_threshold_usd.description: Maximum PayPal-funded resolution center case amount automatically refunded in USD. `null` when automatic refunds are disabled for PayPal.

created_at.description: When the account was created, as an ISO 8601 timestamp.

day.description: Day the automatic withdrawal runs on: 0-6 (Sunday-Saturday) for `weekly`, 1-31 for `monthly`. `null` for `manual` and `daily`.

next_payout_date.description: Next date the automatic withdrawal is scheduled to run, as an ISO 8601 date. `null` for `manual` and `daily`, where no single next date applies.

call_to_action.description: The call-to-action button shown on the ad.

click_through_rate.description: Clicks divided by impressions, between 0 and 1.

completed_registration_value.description: USD value attributed to complete-registration events. Sums the value sent with each event, normalized to USD; events without a value contribute 0.

contact_value.description: USD value attributed to contact events. Sums the value sent with each event, normalized to USD; events without a value contribute 0.

cost_per_added_to_cart.description: Spend divided by attributed add-to-cart events; null when they are not the goal and none are attributed.

cost_per_click.description: Spend divided by clicks; 0 when there are no clicks.

cost_per_completed_registration.description: Spend divided by attributed complete-registration events; null when they are not the goal and none are attributed.

cost_per_contact.description: Spend divided by attributed contact events; null when contacts are not the goal and none are attributed.

cost_per_lead.description: Spend divided by attributed leads; null when leads are not a goal and none are attributed.

cost_per_mille.description: Spend per 1,000 impressions; 0 when there are no impressions.

cost_per_purchase.description: Spend divided by attributed purchases; null when purchases are not a goal and none are attributed.

cost_per_result.description: Spend divided by Whop pixel-attributed results; null when nothing Whop-attributable is being optimized for.

cost_per_schedule.description: Spend divided by attributed schedule events; null when schedules are not the goal and none are attributed.

cost_per_submitted_application.description: Spend divided by attributed submit-application events; null when they are not the goal and none are attributed.

cost_per_unique_click.description: Spend divided by unique clicks; null when there are no unique clicks.

cost_per_viewed_content.description: Spend divided by attributed view-content events; null when they are not the goal and none are attributed.

created_at.description: When the ad was created, as an ISO 8601 timestamp.

items.description: The creative assets used by this ad. The original asset has a null format; square, vertical, and horizontal entries are placement-specific variants. A carousel ad returns one format-null entry per attachment, in order.

custom_conversions.description: Whop pixel-attributed custom (merchant-defined) conversion events, last-click, across all custom event names.

custom_event_counts.description: Whop pixel-attributed custom conversions, keyed by your event name with its last-click count as the value. Empty when no named custom events are attributed. Custom events fired without a name are counted in custom_conversions but omitted here, so these values sum to at most custom_conversions.

custom_event_values.description: Conversion value attributed to each custom event, keyed by event name like custom_event_counts. Sums the value passed to whop.track, normalized to USD; events fired without a value contribute 0.

delivery_status.description: Whether the ad is delivering right now, and if not, why. When several states apply at once, the highest-precedence one is returned.

items.description: The description shown on the ad. Entries with a null language are the ad's own copy; a Meta ad with translations also carries one entry per other language.

existing_post_id.description: The post you pointed this ad at, when it promotes one you already published — a Facebook post, Instagram media, or TikTok video ID. `null` when the ad uses uploaded creatives.

items.description: The external accounts the ad runs under — its Facebook page and Instagram profile — each referenced by ID, prefixed `sacc_`.
The headline shown on the ad. Entries with a null language are the ad's own copy; a Meta ad with translations also carries one entry per other language.

id.description: Unique identifier for the ad, prefixed `ad_`.

items.description: Open issues affecting this ad. Empty when there are none.

lead_form.description: The instant lead form shown when someone taps this ad. `null` when the ad group's conversion_location is not an instant-form destination.

lead_form_id.description: The ad platform's ID for the instant form the ad uses. Set when the ad references an existing form via `lead_form_id`, or once a form built from `lead_form` has been created on the platform.

lead_value.description: USD value attributed to lead events. Sums the value sent with each event, normalized to USD; events without a value contribute 0.

link_clicks.description: Page views on your destination from people who clicked the ad, recorded by the Whop pixel. Counted the same way on every ad platform.

messaging_config.description: Welcome message for click-to-message ads, shown when the conversation opens. `null` when the ad has none.

multi_advertiser_ads.description: Whether the ad can appear alongside other advertisers' ads in the same unit. Defaults to true.

music.description: The advertiser-uploaded MP3 a TikTok carousel ad plays. TikTok-only; `null` elsewhere and for non-carousel ads.

platform.description: The ad platform this ad runs on.

post_id.description: The post the ad network serves for this ad, as `pageID_postID` on Meta — the post Meta created for an uploaded creative, or the post being promoted. Use it to open the live post, or to promote the same post from another ad. `null` until the network has created the post.

post_source.description: Identifies the network that owns `existing_post_id`; `null` when the ad uses uploaded creatives.

post_thumbnail_url.description: Preview image of the post named by `existing_post_id`. `null` for ads that use uploaded creatives, or until the post's media has been fetched from the network.

items.description: The primary text shown in the ad body. Entries with a null language are the ad's own copy (several make text variations); a Meta ad with translations also carries one entry per other language.

reach.description: The number of unique people who saw this.

result_event.description: The Whop pixel conversion event whose attributed count represents results — the optimization goal, or the highest-volume attributed event for campaigns that budget per ad group. Null when the goal isn't a Whop-attributed event.

result_event_name.description: The merchant-defined event name when result_event is custom; null for the standard events.

results.description: The Whop pixel-attributed count behind result_event. When a campaign's ad groups optimize different goals there is no single result_event (it is null), and this is instead the sum of each ad group's own attributed results. Null when nothing Whop-attributable is being optimized for.

return_on_ad_spend.description: Purchase value divided by spend, both in USD (a currency-neutral ratio); 0 when there is no spend.

schedule_value.description: USD value attributed to schedule events. Sums the value sent with each event, normalized to USD; events without a value contribute 0.

spend_currency.description: The ISO 4217 currency code of all monetary metrics.

status.description: Whether the ad is enabled. `active` and `paused` are set by you; `in_review` and `rejected` come from ad review.

submitted_application_value.description: USD value attributed to submit-application events. Sums the value sent with each event, normalized to USD; events without a value contribute 0.

title.description: Display title of the ad.

translations.description: The languages a Meta ad runs in besides its own. Each viewer sees the version for their language, or the ad's own copy. `null` when the ad runs in one language.

unique_click_through_rate.description: Unique clicks divided by impressions, between 0 and 1.

unique_clicks.description: People who clicked, reported by the Whop pixel, counted once per person.

updated_at.description: When the ad was last updated, as an ISO 8601 timestamp.

url.description: The URL the ad links to, without its query string. Parameters belong in `url_parameters`; any you send on `url` are moved there.

url_parameters.description: Every query parameter appended to the URL, keyed by parameter name — including any you sent on `url` itself. Whop adds its own click-attribution parameters on top; those are reserved and rejected if you set them. Which keys are reserved depends on the ad's network — Meta: utm_meta_ad_id, utm_meta_adset_id, utm_meta_campaign_id, utm_source, utm_placement, utm_medium, utm_content, utm_adset, utm_whop, wacid, wasid, waid, tw_source, tw_adid; TikTok: waid, wasid, wacid, ad_id, adset_id, campaign_id, utm_source, utm_medium, utm_placement, utm_whop, tw_source, tw_adid.

viewed_content_value.description: USD value attributed to view-content events. Sums the value sent with each event, normalized to USD; events without a value contribute 0.

added_to_cart_value.description: USD value attributed to add-to-cart events. Sums the value sent with each event, normalized to USD; events without a value contribute 0.

budget_amount.description: The campaign's budget in USD, which is what it is stored and billed in. `null` when each ad group sets its own budget instead.

budget_amount.description: This ad group's budget in USD, which is what it is stored and billed in. `null` when the budget is set on the campaign instead.

budget_currency.description: The ISO 4217 code `budget_amount_local` is in: the account's `ads_reporting_currency` preference. `usd` unless the account changed it.

budget_type.description: Whether `budget_amount` is spent per day (`daily`) or over the ad group's full run (`lifetime`). A `lifetime` ad group also needs `ends_at`, at least 24 hours after it starts.

click_through_rate.description: Clicks divided by impressions, between 0 and 1.

completed_registration_value.description: USD value attributed to complete-registration events. Sums the value sent with each event, normalized to USD; events without a value contribute 0.

contact_value.description: USD value attributed to contact events. Sums the value sent with each event, normalized to USD; events without a value contribute 0.

conversion_location.description: Where the outcome being optimized for occurs, such as a website visit, social-profile visit, messaging conversation, ad interaction, or lead-form submission.

cost_per_added_to_cart.description: Spend divided by attributed add-to-cart events; null when they are not the goal and none are attributed.

cost_per_click.description: Spend divided by clicks; 0 when there are no clicks.

cost_per_completed_registration.description: Spend divided by attributed complete-registration events; null when they are not the goal and none are attributed.

cost_per_contact.description: Spend divided by attributed contact events; null when contacts are not the goal and none are attributed.

cost_per_lead.description: Spend divided by attributed leads; null when leads are not a goal and none are attributed.

cost_per_mille.description: Spend per 1,000 impressions; 0 when there are no impressions.

cost_per_purchase.description: Spend divided by attributed purchases; null when purchases are not a goal and none are attributed.

cost_per_result.description: Spend divided by Whop pixel-attributed results; null when nothing Whop-attributable is being optimized for.

cost_per_schedule.description: Spend divided by attributed schedule events; null when schedules are not the goal and none are attributed.

cost_per_submitted_application.description: Spend divided by attributed submit-application events; null when they are not the goal and none are attributed.

cost_per_unique_click.description: Spend divided by unique clicks; null when there are no unique clicks.

cost_per_viewed_content.description: Spend divided by attributed view-content events; null when they are not the goal and none are attributed.

created_at.description: When the ad group was created, as an ISO 8601 timestamp.

custom_conversions.description: Whop pixel-attributed custom (merchant-defined) conversion events, last-click, across all custom event names.

custom_event_counts.description: Whop pixel-attributed custom conversions, keyed by your event name with its last-click count as the value. Empty when no named custom events are attributed. Custom events fired without a name are counted in custom_conversions but omitted here, so these values sum to at most custom_conversions.

custom_event_values.description: Conversion value attributed to each custom event, keyed by event name like custom_event_counts. Sums the value passed to whop.track, normalized to USD; events fired without a value contribute 0.

delivery_schedule.description: Hours the ad group delivers in each week, keyed by day. Days it doesn't deliver are omitted. `null` when it delivers at every hour. Some platforms need a lifetime `budget_type` for a schedule, on the ad group or on its campaign when the campaign holds the budget.

delivery_status.description: Whether ads in this ad group are delivering right now, and if not, why. When several states apply at once, the highest-precedence one is returned.

desired_cost_per_result.description: Cost per result to aim for (`average_target`) or never exceed (`maximum_target`). `null` for `minimum_cost` bidding.

detailed_targeting.description: Interest, behavior, and demographic targeting, using categories from the ad platform's targeting taxonomy. Entries across interests, behaviors, and demographics are OR'd together (anyone matching any entry is reached), matching Ads Manager's detailed-targeting box. Can't be combined with automatic audience targeting. Special ad category campaigns are limited to approved interests.

devices.description: Device platforms and operating systems targeted.

dynamic_creative.description: Whether the ad platform automatically mixes and matches this ad group's creatives and copy to find the best-performing combinations.

ends_at.description: When the ad group stops delivering, as an ISO 8601 timestamp. `null` when it runs until paused.

frequency_cap.description: Cap on how often one person sees ads from this ad group, or from the whole campaign under a campaign budget, where every ad group shares it. Only available when the ad group optimizes for reach or ThruPlay; `null` when uncapped.

id.description: Unique identifier for the ad group, prefixed `adgrp_`.

items.description: Open issues affecting this ad group and its ads. Empty when there are none.
Search terms this ad group's ads can show for, and terms they never show for. Search campaigns only, where each ad group needs at least one before launch.
Languages targeted, as ISO 639 codes such as `en` or `es`. A region-specific locale with no ISO code appears as its numeric platform locale key. Empty targets all languages.

lead_value.description: USD value attributed to lead events. Sums the value sent with each event, normalized to USD; events without a value contribute 0.

learning_progress.description: Progress toward the ad platform's learning conversion threshold for this ad group. Null unless it is learning or learning limited and the platform reports valid counts. Reaching the threshold does not determine delivery status.

link_clicks.description: Page views on your destination from people who clicked the ad, recorded by the Whop pixel. Counted the same way on every ad platform.

items.description: Apps the conversation opens in when `conversion_location` is `messaging`. Empty for other conversion locations.

minimum_daily_spend.description: Minimum the ad group tries to spend each day. `null` when no floor is set.

optimization_goal.description: The result the ad group's delivery is optimized to get the most of.

items.description: Where ads can appear, per platform. Empty when placements are chosen automatically.

platform.description: The ad platform this ad group runs on.

reach.description: The number of unique people who saw this.

regions.description: Locations targeted and excluded.

result_event.description: The Whop pixel conversion event whose attributed count represents results — the optimization goal, or the highest-volume attributed event for campaigns that budget per ad group. Null when the goal isn't a Whop-attributed event.

result_event_name.description: The merchant-defined event name when result_event is custom; null for the standard events.

results.description: The Whop pixel-attributed count behind result_event. When a campaign's ad groups optimize different goals there is no single result_event (it is null), and this is instead the sum of each ad group's own attributed results. Null when nothing Whop-attributable is being optimized for.

return_on_ad_spend.description: Purchase value divided by spend, both in USD (a currency-neutral ratio); 0 when there is no spend.

schedule_value.description: USD value attributed to schedule events. Sums the value sent with each event, normalized to USD; events without a value contribute 0.

spend_currency.description: The ISO 4217 currency code of all monetary metrics.

starts_at.description: When the ad group starts delivering, as an ISO 8601 timestamp. `null` when it starts as soon as it's active.

status.description: Whether the ad group is enabled. `active` and `paused` are set by you; `rejected` means it failed ad review; `duplicating` is a copy still being filled in.

submitted_application_value.description: USD value attributed to submit-application events. Sums the value sent with each event, normalized to USD; events without a value contribute 0.

title.description: Display name of the ad group.

unique_click_through_rate.description: Unique clicks divided by impressions, between 0 and 1.

unique_clicks.description: People who clicked, reported by the Whop pixel, counted once per person.

updated_at.description: When the ad group was last updated, as an ISO 8601 timestamp.

viewed_content_value.description: USD value attributed to view-content events. Sums the value sent with each event, normalized to USD; events without a value contribute 0.
