amount.description: The amount in major units, as an exact decimal string — `"10.00"` is ten dollars. A string so no float rounds it in transit.

currency.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code, lowercase.

decimals.description: How many decimal places the amount CARRIES — the precision the charge itself runs at.

display_decimals.description: How many decimal places to SHOW. Usually equal to `decimals`, and deliberately not always: COP is charged in centavos but written in whole pesos, so it is `2` and `0`. Format the number in your own locale using this.

account.description: Account the notification belongs to. `null` when the notification is not associated with an account.

attachment_url.description: Image displayed alongside the notification — the sender's avatar, or the default notification image.

content.description: The body text of the notification displayed to the user.

created_at.description: When the notification was created, as an ISO 8601 timestamp.

experience.description: Experience the notification is related to. `null` when not tied to a specific experience.

id.description: Notification ID. Feed rows carry a composite id that doubles as the list cursor.

iframe_link.description: The same destination on the app's own domain, which the Whop web and mobile clients embed instead of navigating to it. Only relevant if you render Whop apps yourself. `null` when the notification carries its own `link`.

link.description: The whop.com page the notification opens, as a normal top-level navigation. This is the link to use unless you host Whop apps yourself. `null` when the notification has no click-through destination.

mentions_me.description: Whether the authenticated user was directly mentioned in this notification.

rest_path.description: Additional path information appended to the notification's deep link, if any.

sender.description: User who triggered the notification. `null` when it was system-generated.

subject.description: The title line of the notification displayed to the user.

topic.description: Topic category the notification belongs to, used for grouping and preference management. `null` when uncategorized.

id.description: Account ID, prefixed `biz_`.

logo_url.description: Account logo image URL. `null` when the account has not uploaded one.

route.description: URL slug of the account's store page on whop.com.

title.description: Account display name.

account_id.description: Account the experience belongs to, prefixed `biz_`.

has_unread.description: Whether the caller has unread notifications in this experience.

important_count.description: Number of unread important (mention) notifications in this experience.

last_viewed_at.description: When the caller last viewed the experience, as an ISO 8601 timestamp. `null` when never viewed.

id.description: Experience ID, prefixed `exp_`.

name.description: Display name of the experience.

icon_url.description: Icon image URL. Always present — the default app icon when none is uploaded.

id.description: App ID, prefixed `app_`.

account_id.description: Account the preference is scoped to (member notifications), prefixed `biz_`.

channel.description: Delivery channel the preference applies to. `null` applies to every channel.

experience_id.description: Experience the preference is scoped to, prefixed `exp_`.

team_account_id.description: Account whose team notifications the preference is scoped to, prefixed `biz_`.

topic_id.description: Notification topic the preference is scoped to, prefixed `topic_`.

level.description: What the user is now notified about in this scope, or `null` if the preference was cleared and the scope inherits its default again.

object.description: Which kind of preference was written: `experience_notification_preference` for an experience level, `notification_preference` for a topic override.

scope.description: The scope that was written, resolved. `null` on a dimension means the preference is not narrowed there.

id.description: User ID, prefixed `user_`.

name.description: Display name.

username.description: Public username.

default_preference_value.description: Whether notifications for this topic are enabled by default when the user has not set a preference.

description.description: Human-readable explanation of what notifications in this topic are about. `null` when no description has been set.
description.example: A customer books and pays for a detail

id.description: Notification topic ID, prefixed `topic_`. This is the value the notification preference endpoints take as `topic_id`.

identifier.description: Stable, human-readable name for the category, such as `new-follower`. Unlike `id`, it is the same in every environment, which makes it the value to match on in code and to read in logs. Treat it as an opaque string: the set is open and the casing is historical rather than normalized.

is_mention.description: Whether this topic exclusively handles mention-based notifications.

name.description: Display name shown in notification preference settings.

topic_type.description: Scope of the topic: whether it applies to an account, a user, or an account's team.

default_preference_value.description: Whether notifications for this topic are enabled by default when the user has not set a preference.

id.description: Notification topic ID, prefixed `topic_`.

is_mention.description: Whether this topic exclusively handles mention-based notifications.

topic_type.description: Scope of the topic: whether it applies to an account, a user, or an account's team.

account_id.description: The account the grant is scoped to, prefixed `biz_`. `null` when the user authorized the app for themselves rather than for one of their accounts.

app_id.description: The app this grant authorizes, prefixed `app_`.

authorized_at.description: When the user last authorized the app, as an ISO 8601 timestamp.

created_at.description: When the user first authorized the app, as an ISO 8601 timestamp.

id.description: Grant ID, prefixed `oag_`.

redirect_url.description: Where to send the user to finish the flow: the `redirect_uri` you supplied with the authorization `code` appended, and `state` when you supplied one. Its scheme, host, port, and path come back exactly as sent — never re-cased or re-encoded — because the client matches them against its registered URI. Returned only once, on create: the code is single-use and expires 10 minutes after it is issued, so redirect immediately.

revoked_at.description: When the grant was revoked, as an ISO 8601 timestamp, or `null` while it is still in force. A revoked grant authorizes nothing — treat its `scopes` as no longer granted.

items.description: Every permission the user has granted this app, accumulated across authorizations, for example `member:basic:read`. `GET /api_keys/permissions` names and describes each one.

current.description: Current level, from `0` before the first threshold up to `10`.

points.description: Points earned this month across every account the owner owns.

points_by_source.description: This month's points, split by where they were earned.

points_to_next.description: Points still needed this month to reach the next level, or `null` at level `10`.

resets_at.description: When this month's points reset to zero, as an ISO 8601 timestamp.

ads.description: Points from charged Whop Ads spend: 10 for every whole dollar.

cards.description: Points from Whop Card spend: 10 for every whole dollar.

trading.description: Points from perpetual trading volume: 1 for every whole dollar traded.

PageInfo.description: Information about pagination in a connection.

end_cursor.description: When paginating forwards, the cursor to continue.

has_next_page.description: When paginating forwards, are there more items?

has_previous_page.description: When paginating backwards, are there more items?

start_cursor.description: When paginating backwards, the cursor to continue.

account_id.description: The business whose `payout_rates` these are, prefixed `biz_`, when the request sent `account_id`. `null` when the rates are the caller's own.

certification_complete.description: Whether the user finished the partner certification course: every visible quiz and knowledge check has a passing result, or, when the course has none, every visible lesson is marked completed.

joined_at.description: When the user joined the partner program, as an ISO 8601 timestamp. Null when they have not joined.

items.description: Default payout percentages grouped by referral tier, with one earning duration per tier. The business's when the request sent `account_id`, else the caller's own. Existing businesses can have individual terms.

referred_businesses_count.description: Number of active first-tier business referrals attributed to the partner, excluding deleted businesses.

referring_partner.description: The user currently attributed as this user's primary referrer. Null when there is no active primary referral.

user.description: The authenticated partner's public profile.

verification_waitlist_joined.description: Whether the user has a pending or approved personal entry on the Verified Partner waitlist.

whop_partner_verified_at.description: When the user became a verified Whop Partner, as an ISO 8601 timestamp. `null` if not verified.

activity_30_day.description: Qualifying card and BNPL payment volume in the preceding 30 days, in USD. Available on business detail responses before acceptance.

activity_60_day.description: Actual payment volume (cards and BNPL) in the preceding 60 days, in USD. Null when unavailable.

amount.description: The offered or accepted upfront CPA payment in USD.

clawed_back_at.description: When low activity triggered reversal and normal partner terms resumed. No prior commissions are paid retroactively.

deadline_at.description: End of the nine-month CPA term. Normal commissions resume prospectively without backfill.

estimated_amount.description: Estimated advance using the current CPA formula and observed payout rates, or current reference card pricing when qualifying payment history is unavailable. Available for unqualified projections on business detail responses; not a final offer.

funded_at.description: When the CPA payment was funded.

offer_token.description: Signed offer valid for 15 minutes. Submit unchanged when accepting. Null unless the caller may accept this offer.

processing_target.description: Processing required in a rolling 30-day period to qualify, in USD.

projected_60_day_activity.description: Projected payment volume (cards and BNPL) over 60 days, in USD.

projected_commissions.description: Projected commissions over the remaining CPA term.

projected_processing_commissions.description: Processing commissions projected for the remaining CPA term, in USD.

recovery_threshold.description: 20% of projected 60-day payment volume (cards and BNPL). Performance checks begin 60 days after funding.

status.description: The CPA payment lifecycle state.

unit.description: Unit of the earning window. Month means a calendar month; day means a day.

value.description: Number of units in the earning window.

income_source.description: Income source that generates this percentage payout.

percentage.description: Partner's default percentage for this tier and income source. For example, 30 means 30%.

duration.description: Default period during which a new referred business can generate commissions, measured from its attribution start. This is not a payout delay. Individual business terms can differ.

items.description: Default payout percentages for each income source in this referral tier.

tier.description: Referral tier: first for a directly referred business, or second for a business brought by a referred partner.

account.description: Business receiving the request, when one is assigned.

authorized_user_id.description: The partner's team membership this referral was created for, prefixed `ausr_`. `null` when the referral is personal.

code.description: Unique referral code, when assigned.

created_at.description: When the request was created, as an ISO 8601 timestamp.

id.description: Partner referral request ID, prefixed `prfr_`.

member_id.description: The partner's member record this referral was created for, prefixed `mber_`, when their role on that business is held on their member record. `null` otherwise.

partner.description: Public profile of the requesting partner.

request_type.description: How the referral request was initiated.

items.description: Rewards offered by this request.

status.description: The approval state, or null for requests without an approval process.

updated_at.description: When the request last changed, as an ISO 8601 timestamp.

user.description: User receiving the attribution request, or null for a business request or referral link.

bot_qualification_type.description: Activity that qualifies for this reward, when specified.

id.description: Partner reward ID, prefixed `prwd_`.

qualification_amount.description: USD amount of qualifying activity required to earn the reward.

recipient.description: Reward recipient's role, or null for a fixed user who is not the requesting partner.

recipient_id.description: Concrete recipient's user or business ID, or null until a business redeems the offer.

created_at.description: When the user registered this passkey, as an ISO 8601 timestamp.

credential_id.description: The WebAuthn credential ID as a base64url string. Pass it in `allowCredentials` when you run a ceremony against this specific passkey.

id.description: Passkey ID, prefixed `wcred_`. Use it to delete the passkey.

last_used_at.description: When this passkey last completed a WebAuthn ceremony, as an ISO 8601 timestamp, or `null` if it never has.

nickname.description: The name the user gave this passkey, usually the device it lives on.

require_resident_key.description: Always `true`. The older form of `resident_key`, for authenticators that predate it.

resident_key.description: The authenticator must store a discoverable passkey, so it can sign in without a username.

user_verification.description: The authenticator must verify the user, with a biometric or the device's screen lock.

challenge.description: The challenge to pass to the WebAuthn ceremony, base64url-encoded without padding. Also inside the options.

creation_options.description: The options for `navigator.credentials.create()` when `challenge_type` is `registration`, otherwise `null`. Convert the keys to camelCase before passing them to the browser.

request_options.description: The options for `navigator.credentials.get()` when `challenge_type` is `deletion`, otherwise `null`. Convert the keys to camelCase before passing them to the browser.

cred_props.description: Asks the authenticator to report whether it stored a discoverable passkey.

attestation.description: Whop does not ask for attestation.

challenge.description: The registration challenge, base64url-encoded without padding.

items.description: The account's existing passkeys, so an authenticator that already holds one does not make a second.
The signature algorithms Whop accepts, most preferred first.

rp.description: The site the passkey belongs to.

timeout.description: How long the ceremony may take, in milliseconds. Matches the challenge's lifetime.

user.description: The account the passkey signs in to.

id.description: The WebAuthn credential ID, base64url-encoded.

items.description: How the authenticator holding this passkey can be reached, as it reported at registration. Empty when unknown.

alg.description: A COSE algorithm identifier: `-7` is ES256, `-257` is RS256.

id.description: The relying party ID, the domain passkeys are bound to.

name.description: The site name an authenticator may show.

items.description: The passkeys that may answer this ceremony.

challenge.description: The assertion challenge, base64url-encoded without padding.

rp_id.description: The site the passkey belongs to.

timeout.description: How long the ceremony may take, in milliseconds. Matches the challenge's lifetime.

user_verification.description: The authenticator must verify the user, with a biometric or the device's screen lock.

display_name.description: The account's name, or its email address when it has none, for passkey pickers that show one.

id.description: The account's passkey user handle, base64url-encoded. Random, the same for every passkey on the account, and never a Whop ID. Send it back as `user_handle` when you register the passkey.

name.description: The account's email address, the identifier a passkey picker shows.

account_id.description: The account that received the payment, prefixed `biz_`.

amount_after_fees.description: What the account keeps: the total less Whop's fees.

auto_capture_at.description: When Whop will capture this authorized card payment automatically unless it is voided first, as an ISO 8601 timestamp. Null when no automatic capture was requested.

auto_refunded.description: True when Whop refunded the payment automatically, for example on a dispute alert.

billing_address.description: The billing address the buyer entered, or null.

billing_reason.description: Why the charge was created: a first purchase, a renewal, a one-time payment, or a manual charge.

capture_expires_at.description: When the hold on this authorized card payment expires if it is not captured first, as an ISO 8601 timestamp. Null when the payment was not created for later capture.

checkout_configuration_id.description: The checkout configuration the buyer paid through, prefixed `ch_`, or null.

client_secret.description: The credential a buyer's surface presents to poll this payment, set its return URL and resume it when the bank asked the customer to authenticate. Only on payments created from a confirmation token or waiting on that authentication, and always null in list responses — retrieve the payment for it.

created_at.description: When the payment was created, as an ISO 8601 timestamp.

currency.description: The currency the payment settles in, lowercase ISO 4217. Every money field below is stated in it unless it says otherwise.

customer_email.description: The buyer's email address. Null without `member:email:read` on the account or when the buyer has no assigned email.

customer_phone.description: The phone number the buyer gave at checkout, when one was collected.

decline_code.description: The normalized decline reason of the most recent failed attempt, or null.

dispute_alerted_at.description: When an issuer warned that this payment will be disputed, or null.

dispute_created_at.description: When the most recent dispute on this payment was opened, as an ISO 8601 timestamp. Null when the payment was never disputed, or without the payment:dispute:read permission.

failure_message.description: Why the most recent attempt failed, in plain words, or null.

financing_installments_count.description: For installment methods, how many payments the charge splits into.

items.description: The active holds on this payment. Each hold has its own release date, independent of `settlement_time_at`. Empty when nothing is held; released holds are omitted.

id.description: Payment ID, prefixed `pay_`.

ip_address.description: The buyer's IP address at checkout: the one Whop's fraud screening identified, otherwise the one Whop captured from the buyer's browser at checkout. Null when the buyer was not present at checkout, such as a subscription renewal or a charge made without the buyer present.

last_payment_attempt_at.description: When the most recent charge attempt ran, or null.

items.description: Everything this payment charged for, in purchase order, with quantities and subtotals in the purchase currency. Payments made before item snapshots were recorded return the single item implied by their variant. Empty when no items or variant can be resolved.

member_id.description: The buyer's member record on the account, prefixed `mber_`. Null without the member:basic:read permission.

membership_id.description: The membership this payment is billed against, prefixed `mem_`. Null for one-off purchases or without the member:basic:read permission.

metadata.description: Your own key-value data attached when the payment was created.

needs_tracking.description: True when funds are held until the order ships and no tracking number has been added yet. Null without the shipment:basic:read permission.

next_payment_attempt_at.description: When the next automatic retry is scheduled, or null.

paid_at.description: When the money was collected, or null while it has not been.

payment_instrument.description: The instrument shaped for display: a buyer-facing name, the standard icon set, and the card's brand, last four and issuer identification number when it was a card.

payment_method_id.description: The stored payment method that was charged, prefixed `payt_`. Null when the method was not saved.

payment_method_type.description: The kind of instrument used, for example `card`, `apple_pay`, `klarna`, or `us_bank_account`.

items.description: The account's own payment rules that decided this payment, recorded when they ran. Only one action is taken per payment, so a rule that matched but was skipped or outranked is not listed. Empty when none decided it, when the account had no rules, or when Whop blocked the payment before they ran.

payments_failed.description: How many charge attempts have failed on this payment.

presentment_refunded_amount.description: How much has been refunded so far, in the currency presented to the buyer. Zero when nothing has been refunded.

presentment_tax_amount.description: The sales tax or VAT collected, in the currency presented to the buyer. Null when no tax applied.

presentment_total.description: The account-facing total in the currency presented to the buyer, before conversion into the settlement currency. Excludes buyer fees.

product_id.description: The product the variant belongs to, prefixed `prod_`. Null for a variant with no product.

promo_code_id.description: The promo code applied at checkout, prefixed `promo_`, or null.

quote_id.description: The payment quote this payment charged, prefixed `pq_`: its purchase, promo code and `tax_amount` are the quote's. Null when the payment named no quote and tax was calculated at charge time.

recovery_url.description: Whop-hosted URL where the buyer can sign in and complete 3D Secure for an off-session charge the bank challenged — a subscription renewal or a saved-card payment. Null when recovery is unavailable, you lack `member:basic:read`, or in list responses. Retrieve the payment for it.

refundable.description: True when the payment is `paid`, not yet fully refunded, and its processor supports refunds.

refunded_amount.description: How much has been refunded so far, as it settled — refunds convert at the rate in force when each one was issued, not the payment's original rate.

refunded_at.description: When the payment was refunded, or null.

response_due_at.description: When the earliest response is due on a dispute or Resolution Center case awaiting the account's response, as an ISO 8601 timestamp. Null when nothing awaits a response, or without the permission to read that dispute or case.

retryable.description: True when the payment is `open` and Whop can attempt the charge again — see `POST /payments/{id}/retry`.

risk_score.description: Whop's published risk index from 0 (lowest) to 100 (highest), including enforced decision floors. This is not a fraud probability. Null when no score is available.

risk_signals.description:
Deprecated. Risk score explanations are no longer provided; always null.
DEPRECATED: Risk score explanations are no longer provided. Always null.

settlement_time_at.description: When the portion not listed in `holds` posts to the account's available balance, at midnight UTC. The `financial_activity.funds_available` webhook's `posted_at` carries the same value when the settlement that clears it posts. Null until the payment is paid, and always null in list responses — retrieve the payment for it.

shipment_id.description: The shipment fulfilling this payment, prefixed `ship_`. Null when nothing ships or without the shipment:basic:read permission.

shipping_address.description: The shipping address for physical goods, or null.

status.description: The lifecycle state of the charge: `open` while collection is outstanding, `paid` once the money moved, `pending` while a settlement rail clears, `void`/`uncollectible` when it ended without collecting.

substatus.description: The dashboard's finer-grained reading of the payment, folding in refunds, disputes and Resolution Center cases.

subtotal.description: The price before discounts, tax and fees.

tax_amount.description: The sales tax or VAT collected. Null when no tax applied.

tax_behavior.description: Whether `tax_amount` was added on top of the price (`exclusive`) or was already inside it (`inclusive`).

tax_refunded_amount.description: How much of the collected tax has been returned to the buyer so far. Zero when the payment carried no tax, or when nothing has been refunded.

three_ds_verified.description: True when the buyer completed 3D Secure for this payment.

total.description: The account-facing total: the price after discounts, plus any tax added on top. Excludes buyer fees, which the buyer pays above this amount — so this is not necessarily what the buyer's statement shows.

updated_at.description: When the payment last changed, as an ISO 8601 timestamp.

usd_total.description: The total converted to USD at the time of the charge, for reporting across currencies. Excludes the adaptive pricing FX markup, which the account does not keep.

user.description: The buyer. Null when the payment belongs to a company buyer rather than a user.

user_agent.description: The buyer's browser user agent at checkout. Null when the buyer was not present at checkout, such as a subscription renewal, or without the member:basic:read permission.

variant_id.description: The variant that was charged, prefixed `plan_`.

verification_checks.description: The Address Verification Service (AVS), cardholder name, and Card Verification Value (CVV/CVC) results, or null when the processor returned none.

voidable.description: True when the payment can be voided or canceled. The request is rejected if the payment is no longer eligible — see `POST /payments/{id}/void`.

wuid.description: The Whop pixel's visitor ID for the buyer's browser at checkout, prefixed `wuid_`. Null when the checkout page had no Whop pixel, when the buyer was not present at checkout, or without the member:basic:read permission.

country.description: The ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code.

name.description: The name on the address.

state.description: The state, province or region.

account_number.description: The account to send to, in the local scheme's format — `account_number_label` says what to call it.

account_number_label.description: What to call `account_number` when showing it, in the local scheme's own terms — `CLABE` in Mexico, for example.

amount.description: Exactly what the buyer must send, in the charged currency.

bank_account_type.description: The kind of account receiving the transfer, such as a checking account, in the local system's own vocabulary.

bank_branch.description: The receiving branch, where the local system routes by branch.

bank_code.description: The code that identifies the receiving bank — its code in the local clearing system, or its SWIFT/BIC on a transfer that crosses borders.

bank_code_label.description: What to call `bank_code` when showing it, in the scheme's own terms — `SWIFT / BIC` on an international wire, for example.

beneficiary_document.description: The account holder's tax or identity document number, where the local system needs it to send.

beneficiary_document_type.description: What kind of document `beneficiary_document` is, in the local system's own vocabulary.

beneficiary_name.description: Who the account belongs to — the name the buyer's bank may ask them to confirm.

document_url.description: A hosted page with the complete, printable instructions. If you would rather not render the details yourself, send the buyer here.

expires_at.description: When these details stop being payable, as an ISO 8601 timestamp.

instructions.description: The rail's own step-by-step payment text, when it supplies one.
instructions.example: Send the exact amount from your own bank account and include the reference SHINE-8237 so the transfer can be matched to your order.

intermediary_bic.description: The SWIFT/BIC of the intermediary bank the buyer's bank should route the transfer through, when the buyer named the bank they are sending from.

reference.description: The reference the buyer must attach to the transfer so it can be matched to this payment.

routing_number.description: The receiving bank's routing number for US transfers.

secondary_account_number.description: A second account number, where the rail publishes the same destination in more than one format.

secondary_account_number_label.description: What to call `secondary_account_number` when showing it.

kind.description: Always `bank_transfer`: account details the buyer sends money to from their own bank.

country.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code.

email.description: Email supplied when the method was collected.

name.description: Name on the payment method.

collected_at.description: When the fee was collected, as an ISO 8601 timestamp, or null when it has not been.

description.description: A longer explanation of the fee, when there is one.

label.description: The name the dashboard shows for this fee.

origin.description: The specific fee this line is, such as `payment_processing_percentage_fee` or `revshare_percentage_fee`.

settlement_amount.description: The fee converted to the payment's settlement currency, so lines can be totalled against the payment.

type.description: The family the fee belongs to: `whop_fee`, `processing_fee`, `affiliate_program_fee`, or `other_fee`.

percentage.description: The reserve percentage recorded when the hold was created, for example 3.5 for 3.5%. Null for other hold types or when no percentage was recorded.

release_at.description: When the held funds are scheduled to become available, as an ISO 8601 timestamp. Never earlier than the payment's settlement date. Null when release depends on an event, such as shipment resolution, rather than a date.

type.description: The reason funds are held: `reserve`, `bnpl`, `sequra`, `fraud_hold`, or `preshipment_hold`.

PaymentInput.description: The account, variant and promo code for a purchase.

account_id.description: The account the purchase belongs to, prefixed `biz_`.

promo_code.description: The promo code as the buyer typed it, matched within the account regardless of case and surrounding spaces, as checkout matches it. It must be valid for the variant. Send it or `promo_code_id`, not both; an empty or whitespace-only string counts as not sent. A code the account does not have, or one that is no longer active, is refused before anything is written, with the error code `promo_invalid`. A code this purchase cannot use, such as one with no uses left or one restricted to other variants, products or buyers, is refused with `promo_invalid` too, and the error's message says why.

promo_code_id.description: An active promo code to apply, prefixed `promo_`. It must belong to the account and be valid for the variant. Send it or `promo_code`, not both. A code this purchase cannot use is refused with the error code `promo_invalid`, and the error's message says why.

variant.description: The variant purchased, described by its attributes instead of an id: the variant with exactly these attributes is used, and one is created when none exists. Mutually exclusive with `variant_id` and `line_items`. Creating a variant requires `plan:create`; creating or updating a product requires the corresponding product permission.

allow_multiple_quantity.description: Whether more than one unit can be purchased in an order. Renewal variants cannot enable it. When `false`, checkouts, carts, and invoices reject a quantity above 1.

application_fee_amount.description: Application fee the platform collects per unit, in the variant currency (5.00 means $5.00 for USD). Must be positive and below the initial price for one-time variants or renewal price for recurring variants. Paid to the parent account alongside other processing fees; collection is capped to remaining proceeds. Applies to subsequent payments on recurring variants. Only valid for connected accounts with a parent account.

billing_period.description: Recurring billing interval in days.

currency.description: Currency code for the variant prices.

description.description: Variant description.

force_create_new_plan.description: Create a new variant instead of reusing a matching variant.

initial_price.description: Additional amount charged on the first purchase, in the variant currency. For recurring variants without a trial, the first charge includes this amount plus renewal_price.

override_tax_type.description: Whether the variant's price includes tax: `inclusive` (tax is included in the price), `exclusive` (tax is added on top), or `unspecified`. Omit it or pass `null` to use the account's tax setting. On an account enrolled in the Whop tax service, `inclusive` or `exclusive` replaces the account's setting and `unspecified` keeps it. Otherwise it applies only where the account is the merchant of record: `inclusive` or `exclusive` replaces the account's setting when the account collects tax, and `unspecified` means the variant collects no tax. Where Whop is the merchant of record, the account's setting applies. Variants that differ only in this value are different variants.

product.description: Find or create a product by external identifier. Mutually exclusive with product_id.

collect_shipping_address.description: Whether to collect a shipping address at checkout.

custom_statement_descriptor.description: Custom card statement descriptor for the product, starting with WHOP*.

renewal_price.description: Recurring price in the variant currency.

trial_period_days.description: Free trial days before renewal.

visibility.description: Whether the variant is visible to customers.

variant_id.description: The variant purchased, prefixed `plan_`. It must belong to the account. Mutually exclusive with `variant` and `line_items`.

Every detail field is optional — the rails behind these methods publish them unevenly — but a kind that arrives with `document_url` can always fall back to sending the buyer to that hosted copy of the instructions.

currency.description: The three-letter ISO currency code for this payment (e.g., 'usd', 'eur').

customer_phone.description: Phone number the customer provided at checkout, or their verified phone number when your checkout requires phone verification. `null` when no phone number was collected.

decline_code.description: The reason the payment was declined. Null if the payment did not fail.

dispute_alerted_at.description: When an alert came in that this transaction will be disputed

failure_message.description: If the payment failed, the reason for the failure.

id.description: The unique identifier for the payment.

last_payment_attempt.description: The time of the last payment attempt.

member.description: The member attached to this payment.

id.description: The unique identifier for the company member.

phone.description: The phone number for the member, if available.

membership.description: The membership attached to this payment.

id.description: The unique identifier for the membership.

phone_number.description: The phone number associated with this membership.

status.description: The state of the membership.

metadata.description: The custom metadata stored on this payment. This will be copied over to the checkout configuration for which this payment was made

needs_tracking.description: Whether this payment is holding funds until the order ships and has no tracking number yet.

next_payment_attempt.description: The time of the next schedule payment retry.

paid_at.description: The time at which this payment was successfully collected. Null if the payment has not yet succeeded. As a Unix timestamp.

payment_instrument.description: The instrument this payment was made with, shaped for display: the method type, a buyer-facing name, the standard icon set, and the card facts when it was a card. Null when the receipt names no payment method.

card.description: Card payments only: the card's network and last four.

brand.description: The network identifier (`visa`, `amex`, …), matching `card.networks` entries and saved card payment methods.

last4.description: The card's last four digits, when captured.

display_name.description: Buyer-facing instrument name — "Visa •••• 4242" when the card surfaced, else the method's own name ("Klarna").

icons.description: The standard icon set: square and card shapes, each in light and dark colorways.

payments_failed.description: The number of failed payment attempts for the payment.

plan.description: The plan attached to this payment.

id.description: The unique identifier for the plan.

internal_notes.description: A personal description or notes section for the business.

metadata.description: Custom key-value pairs stored on the plan. Included in webhook payloads for payment and membership events. Max 50 keys, 100 chars per key, 500 chars per string value. The reserved keys `custom_cta` and `custom_cta_url`, when set, override the product's checkout call to action for this plan.

product.description: The product this payment was made for

id.description: The unique identifier for the product.

metadata.description: Custom key-value pairs stored on the product and included in payment and membership webhook payloads. Max 50 keys, 100 characters per key, 500 characters per string value.

route.description: URL slug in the product's public link, e.g. `pickaxe-analytics` in whop.com/company/pickaxe-analytics.

title.description: The display name of the product shown to customers on the product page and in search results.

promo_code.description: The promo code used for this payment.

amount_off.description: The discount amount. Interpretation depends on promo_type: if 'percentage', this is the percentage (e.g., 20 means 20% off); if 'flat_amount', this is dollars off (e.g., 10.00 means $10.00 off).

base_currency.description: The monetary currency of the promo code.

code.description: The specific code used to apply the promo at checkout.

id.description: The unique identifier for the promo code.

number_of_intervals.description: The number of months the promo is applied for.

promo_type.description: The type (% or flat amount) of the promo.

refundable.description: True only for payments that are `paid`, have not been fully refunded, and were processed by a payment processor that allows refunds.

refunded_at.description: When the payment was refunded (if applicable).

retryable.description: True when the payment status is `open` and its membership is in one of the retry-eligible states (`active`, `trialing`, `completed`, or `past_due`), or when it is a failed initial billing-engine payment on a `drafted` membership with an unlimited-stock plan; otherwise false. Used to decide if Whop can attempt the charge again.

settlement_currency.description: The three-letter ISO currency code for this payment (e.g., 'usd', 'eur').

shipment.description: The shipment attached to this payment.

carrier.description: The shipping carrier detected for this shipment. Null until a tracking update identifies it.

id.description: The unique identifier for the shipment.

status.description: The current delivery status of this shipment.

tracking_number.description: The carrier-assigned tracking number used to look up shipment progress.

tracking_url.description: A customer-facing URL to track this shipment's progress.

shipping_address.description: The shipping address provided by the customer for physical goods. Null if no shipping address was collected.

country.description: The country of the address.

name.description: The name of the customer.

postal_code.description: The postal code of the address.

state.description: The state of the address.

sku.description: The stock keeping unit of the variant this payment charged for (the first item, on a cart), as set by the seller. Accounts with billing-reason SKU suffixes enabled receive it stamped with why the charge happened: `-S` for a first subscription charge, `-R` for a renewal, `-C` for a one-time purchase, `-U` when the payment's own metadata carries `upsell: true`, `-F` when nothing was charged. Other billing reasons carry the bare SKU. Null when the variant has no SKU.

status.description: The current lifecycle state of this payment (e.g., 'draft', 'open', 'paid', 'void').

substatus.description: The friendly status of the payment.

subtotal.description: The subtotal to show to the creator (excluding buyer fees).

tax_amount.description: The calculated amount of the sales/VAT tax (if applicable).

tax_behavior.description: The type of tax inclusivity applied to the payment, for determining whether the tax is included in the final price, or paid on top.

total.description: The total to show to the creator (excluding buyer fees).

updated_at.description: The datetime the payment was last updated.

usd_total.description: The total in USD to show to the creator (excluding buyer fees).

user.description: The user that made this payment.

email.description: The user's email address. Requires the member:email:read permission to access. Null if not authorized.

id.description: The unique identifier for the user.

name.description: The user's display name shown on their public profile.

username.description: The user's unique username shown on their public profile.

voidable.description: True when the payment can be voided or canceled. The request is rejected if the payment is no longer eligible.

PaymentNextAction.description: What the buyer must do to finish. `type` picks the shape and each type carries only its own `data`, so switching on `type` gives you exactly that step's payload.

data.description: How long the wait can last.

items.description: Where this step can be presented: `inline` inside your own page, `full_page` as a top-level navigation. Pick whichever listed mode suits your surface.

type.description: Always `await_confirmation`: nothing to show — the buyer has done their part and the rail settles out of band. Poll `status` until it moves.

expires_at.description: When the confirmation window closes, as an ISO 8601 timestamp. A payment still unconfirmed by then will not succeed — watch `status` for the failed attempt.

data.description: What the Terminal SDK needs to collect this payment.

type.description: Always `collect_card_present`: the buyer taps on the seller's reader. Hand `data.client_secret` to the Terminal SDK to collect and confirm the payment, then poll `status` until it moves.

client_secret.description: The Stripe PaymentIntent client secret the Terminal SDK retrieves, collects and confirms this payment with. Treat it as a credential: together with a card-present connection token it is what a device needs to take the payment.

data.description: The instructions. `kind` picks the shape, and the details sit under the key named for it: `voucher`, `qr`, or `bank_transfer`.

items.description: Where this step can be presented: `inline` inside your own page, `full_page` as a top-level navigation. Pick whichever listed mode suits your surface.

type.description: Always `display_instructions`: show the buyer `data` — what to pay, where, and by when. The payment completes once they pay and the rail confirms it, so keep polling `status`.

items.description: Where this step can be presented: `inline` inside your own page, `full_page` as a top-level navigation. Pick whichever listed mode suits your surface.

type.description: Always `redirect`: send the buyer to `data.url`. The provider hands them back to `return_url` when they are done.

frame_max_width.description: The widest the provider's page lays out usefully, in CSS pixels — cap a frame or dialog presenting it at this width. `null` when the page fills whatever width it is given.

url.description: The provider's page for this payment, as an absolute URL — take the buyer there.

expires_at.description: When the link stops working, as an ISO 8601 timestamp. Generate a new PDF for a fresh link.

url.description: A short-lived link to download the payment's receipt as a PDF. Anyone holding the link can download the file until it expires.

expected_by.description: When the payment is expected to settle, as an ISO 8601 timestamp.

amount.description: Exactly what the buyer must pay, in the charged currency.

copy_code.description: The code the buyer pastes into their payment app instead of scanning, such as Pix's copy-and-paste code, so they can pay from the device showing the QR. Only present for methods that accept a pasted code.

document_url.description: A hosted page with the complete, printable instructions. If you would rather not render the details yourself, send the buyer here.

expires_at.description: When the code stops being payable, as an ISO 8601 timestamp.

key.description: An account key the buyer can pay to directly (Colombia's Bre-B llave), for apps that take a key instead of a scan.

qr_code.description: The QR code's contents, ready to render as a scannable image — `qr_format` says how it is encoded.

kind.description: Always `qr`: a code the buyer scans with their banking app.

account_id.description: The account the purchase is priced for, prefixed `biz_`.

address.description: The billing address the purchase was priced with, or null. Where tax was calculated when no shipping address was given, and the address the registration belongs to.

base_currency.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 code of the variants' own currency, lowercase. Equal to `currency` when nothing was converted.

base_total.description: `total` in `base_currency` at `exchange_rate`: the variants' own prices after the promo code, plus `tax_amount` converted at `exchange_rate` when tax is added on top. Equal to `total` when nothing was converted. The payment charges `total`, in `currency`.

created_at.description: When the quote was priced, as an ISO 8601 timestamp.

currency.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code the purchase is priced and charged in, lowercase: the variants' own currency, or the `presentment_currency` it was converted into.

discount.description: What the promo code takes off. Zero without a code.

exchange_rate.description: How many units of `currency` one unit of `base_currency` buys, as a decimal string such as `"5.4321"`: the rate the variants' prices were converted at, fixed until `expires_at`, and the rate a payment consuming the quote is charged at. A string, like money amounts, so no float rounds it in transit. Null when nothing was converted.

expires_at.description: When the quote stops being chargeable, as an ISO 8601 timestamp. Quote again after it.

id.description: Payment quote ID, prefixed `pq_`.

items.description: One entry per variant, in the order given, each carrying its own tax.

located_by.description: Which location tax was calculated for: `shipping_address` when it carries a country, else the billing `address` when it does, else the `presentment_country` sent, else the buyer's `ip_address`. A quote located by `presentment_country` or `ip_address` is a preview that estimates tax: a payment cannot use it, so quote again with the buyer's address to pay. Null when nothing in the request located the buyer, which only a seller that collects no tax on this purchase is quoted without; `tax_status` is then `not_applicable`.

payment_id.description: The payment holding this quote, prefixed `pay_`, or null while it is unspent. A declined payment keeps its quote and can be retried; check that payment's `status`.

promo_code_id.description: The promo code the quote applied, prefixed `promo_`, or null.

items.description: Lowercase ISO 4217 codes to offer the buyer in a currency picker, most relevant first: the currency of the `presentment_country` sent, else of the country the buyer's `ip_address` is in, when this purchase can be converted into it and a payment method can collect it, then `base_currency`. Quote again with one as `presentment_currency` to price in it. Only `base_currency` when the quote was priced without `presentment_currency` or `presentment_country`.

shipping_address.description: The shipping address the purchase was priced with, or null. When present it is where tax was calculated.

subtotal.description: The price of every line before the promo code, tax and fees.

tax_amount.description: The tax a payment consuming this quote charges. Zero unless `tax_status` is `calculated`.

tax_behavior.description: Whether tax is added on top of the price (`exclusive`) or already inside it (`inclusive`). Null when no tax was calculated.

items.description: The buyer's tax registration the quote priced as a business purchase. Empty for a consumer purchase.

tax_status.description: `calculated`: every line was priced and a payment may consume the quote. `not_applicable`: this seller collects no tax on this purchase, so the quote owes none and may still be consumed. `unavailable`: tax could not be priced — the provider did not answer, or this seller's tax setup cannot price a purchase here — so a payment refuses the quote; quote again, or charge without `quote_id` to have tax calculated at charge time.

total.description: What the buyer pays: the subtotal less the discount, plus `tax_amount` when tax is added on top.

discount.description: The promo code's share on this line. Zero without a code.

quantity.description: How many units of the variant the line covers.

subtotal.description: The line's price before the promo code's share and tax; `subtotal` minus `discount` is what the line comes to after the discount. The lines' subtotals sum to the quote's `subtotal`.

tax_amount.description: The tax on this line. Zero when `tax_status` is not `calculated`.

total.description: `subtotal` minus `discount`, plus `tax_amount` when tax is added on top, or without it when the price already includes it.

variant_id.description: The variant this line prices, prefixed `plan_`. Null when the purchase describes the variant by `variant` and no variant with those attributes exists yet: the payment that consumes the quote creates it, and the line names it from then on.

account_id.description: Account ID, prefixed `biz_`.

action.description: What this account's rule requests when every condition matches. One applicable account-rule action wins, in this order: `allow`, `block`, `review`, `enforce_3ds`. An `allow` overrides this account's other rules, never Whop's own fraud controls. A `review` requests authorization without capture for an eligible on-session card payment through Whop Payments. Automatic capture is scheduled for 48 hours after authorization; capture or void the payment before then to decide sooner. Capture may complete later or fail. Review is skipped for unsupported methods, off-session payments, and payments already configured for manual capture. An `enforce_3ds` is skipped when the account rule cannot apply a challenge. Other 3DS requirements still apply.

conditions.description: The conditions a payment is matched against. Up to 10 conditions, and 8 KiB once serialized.

created_at.description: When the rule was created, as an ISO 8601 timestamp.

deleted_at.description: When the rule was deleted, as an ISO 8601 timestamp. `null` unless `status` is `deleted`.

id.description: Payment rule ID, prefixed `prule_`.

metadata.description: Custom string-to-string values for your integration. Maximum 50 keys, 40 characters per key, 500 characters per value.

name.description: A name for this rule. Up to 255 characters.

status.description: Whether the rule is applied to payments. A `deleted` rule is kept so the payments it already decided still name it.

updated_at.description: When the rule was last changed, as an ISO 8601 timestamp.

field.description: The payment attribute this condition reads.

operator.description: How the payment attribute is compared to the value.

value.description: The value to compare against.

PaymentRuleConditionValue.description: The value to compare against. A whole number from 0 to 100 for `risk_score`, a number of at least 0 for `amount_in_usd`, a string for the other fields, and an array of strings for the `in` and `not_in` operators.

items.description: Conditions that must all match for the rule to apply. A payment attribute the rule cannot read does not match.

field.description: The payment attribute this condition reads.

maximum.description: The largest value this field accepts, or `null` when the field is not numeric.

minimum.description: The smallest value this field accepts, or `null` when the field is not numeric.

items.description: The operators this field accepts. Any other operator is rejected.
The values this field accepts, or `null` when the field is free-form.

type.description: The type of value this field compares against.

label.description: The name to display for this value.

value.description: The value to send in a condition.

id.description: Payment rule ID, prefixed `prule_`.

name.description: The rule's name when it matched. Renaming the rule afterwards does not rewrite this.

account.description: The account receiving this payment, or `null` when the payment has no associated account.

auto_capture_at.description: When Whop will capture this authorization automatically, as an ISO 8601 timestamp. `null` when no automatic capture was requested.

capture_expires_at.description: When the card authorization must be captured, as an ISO 8601 timestamp. `null` when this payment was not authorized for later capture.

id.description: The payment this status describes, prefixed `pay_`.

last_payment_error.description: Details of the most recent failed attempt, or `null` when the payment has not failed.

next_action.description: What the buyer must do next while `status` is `requires_action`, otherwise `null`. `type` picks the shape and each variant carries only its own `data`, so switching on `type` gives you exactly that step's payload. The `collect_card_present` step is served only to a credential holding `payment:charge` on the account; any other reader sees `null` while the tap is outstanding.

processing_details.description: Present while `status` is `processing` on a settlement rail, otherwise `null`. A `processing` status without it has not been decided yet — keep polling.

return_url.description: Where to send the buyer once the payment reaches a resting state, or `null` to leave them where they are. Editable until they return — see the return_url operation.

status.description: How far the payment has got. `requires_confirmation` — nothing attempted yet, or the last attempt failed and can be retried. `requires_action` — the buyer has a step outstanding; see `next_action`. `requires_capture` — the card authorization is holding funds and must be captured. `confirming` — the buyer has done their part and the processor is deciding. `processing` — with `processing_details`, the money is moving; without them, the charge is still being decided and the status should be read again. `succeeded` — collected. `canceled` — voided or written off.

action.description: The permission action's identifier, for example `company:basic:read`.

allowed_on_api_key.description: Whether an API key can be granted the permission.

allowed_on_app.description: Whether an app can request and be granted the permission.

allowed_on_user.description: Whether the permission can be granted to user tokens.

PermissionAction.description: A permission action identifier, such as `company:basic:read`.

affiliate_tracking_detected.description: Whether an affiliate tracking SDK was found on the page at `url`. Supported platforms: Everflow.

firing_data_ok.description: False when the event lookup failed, meaning `host_events` and `last_seen_days` are incomplete.

items.description: Conversion event names detected on the requested page or fired recently anywhere on its hostname or final redirect hostname.

installed.description: Whether the pixel was seen. Without a `url` this answers for the whole account: true when it has sent events recently. With a `url` it answers for THAT page only — true when the page is hosted on Whop, when the page itself has sent events recently, or when the pixel was found in its source. Events the account sent from other pages do not make a given `url` installed.

last_fired_days.description: Event name to whole days since that event last fired, e.g. `{ "lead": 3 }`. Carries events that fired too long ago to count as installed, so you can prompt to re-check rather than report them missing.

last_seen_days.description: Days since the pixel last sent an event, within a 30-day window. `null` when it hasn't sent one in that window — which includes a pixel installed moments ago.

native_tracking.description: True when `url` is hosted on Whop, so no pixel snippet is required.

items.description: Conversion event names detected on the requested page, from its recent events or its source and linked scripts.

reachable.description: Whether the page could be loaded. `null` when the request included no URL, and `true` when events settled the answer without a fetch.

url.description: The URL that was checked, after normalization. `null` when the request didn't include one.

account.description: Account that sells this variant; `null` for standalone invoice variants.

adaptive_pricing_enabled.description: Whether adaptive pricing is enabled for this variant. Raw setting — does not check processor compatibility or feature flags.

allow_multiple_quantity.description: Whether more than one unit can be purchased in an order. Renewal variants cannot enable it. When `false`, checkouts, carts, and invoices reject a quantity above 1.

attributes.description: Attribute values that distinguish this variant within its product, as a map of attribute name to value, e.g. `{"color": "Blue", "size": "Large"}`. Names are snake_case identifiers and come back in alphabetical order. Every attributed variant on a product carries the same attribute names and a distinct set of values; the product lists the full option set as `variant_attributes`. `null` when the variant has no attributes.

billing_period.description: Number of days between recurring charges, such as 30 for monthly or 365 for annual. `null` for one-time variants.

cancel_discount_intervals.description: How long the cancellation discount lasts: `0` forever, `1` the next payment only, or a number of calendar months from when the customer accepts it. `null` when none is offered or the actor lacks the `plan:basic:read` scope.

cancel_discount_percentage.description: Cancellation discount as a whole-number percentage. `null` when none is offered or the actor lacks the `plan:basic:read` scope.

checkout_styling.description: Variant-level checkout styling (`background_color`, `button_color`, `font_family`, `border_style`); `null` inherits the account default.

collect_tax.description: Whether tax is collected on purchases of this variant, based on the account's tax configuration.

created_at.description: When the variant was created, as an ISO 8601 timestamp.

currency.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 code of the currency every price on this variant is stated in, lowercase: the variant's own currency, or the `presentment_currency` the read asked for when the variant can be converted into it.

items.description: Custom input fields collected on the checkout form.

deletable.description: Whether the variant can be deleted (it has no memberships or waitlist entries). `null` unless the actor has the `plan:basic:read` scope on the variant's account.

description.description: Customer-visible variant description. Maximum 1000 characters. `null` if no description is set.

effective_payment_method_configuration.description: The configuration governing a checkout for this variant, resolved through every layer (the variant's own and the account's) — the shape a session's `payment_method_configuration` carries. Apply it over the payment method types catalogue for the offerable set. `null` means platform defaults; `payment_method_configuration` stays the variant's own editable override.

expiration_days.description: Access duration in days for expiration-based variants, such as 365 for a one-year pass. `null` for variants without an expiration.

formatted_price.description: Human-readable price for display (currency + interval) in `currency`, e.g. "$10 / month".

id.description: Variant ID, prefixed `plan_`.

image.description: Pricing-tier image (`url`, `blurhash`) shown on the product page; `null` when no image is set.

initial_price.description: Initial purchase price, in `currency`.

initial_price_due.description: Total charged at checkout for one unit, before promo codes and tax: `initial_price` plus the first `renewal_price` for recurring variants, or `initial_price` alone while a free trial applies. The trial does not apply when the viewing user has already used one for this variant. Stated in `currency`.

internal_notes.description: Private notes not shown to customers. `null` unless the actor has the `plan:basic:read` scope on the variant's account.
internal_notes.example: Maintenance tier. Upsell the interior shampoo add-on at renewal.

invoice.description: Invoice this variant was generated for; `null` unless created for an invoice.

member_count.description: Active memberships through this variant. `null` unless the actor has the `plan:basic:read` scope on the variant's account.

metadata.description: Custom key-value pairs stored on the variant. Included in webhook payloads for payment and membership events. Maximum 50 keys, 100 characters per key, 500 characters per value. The reserved keys `custom_cta` and `custom_cta_url`, when set, override the product's checkout call to action for this variant.

offer_cancel_discount.description: Whether a cancellation discount is offered. `null` unless the actor has the `plan:basic:read` scope on the variant's account.

payment_method_configuration.description: Payment method configuration (`enabled`, `disabled`, `include_platform_defaults`); `null` when variant uses default settings.

product.description: Product this variant belongs to; `null` for standalone variants.

purchase_url.description: URL where customers can purchase this variant directly.

renewal_price.description: Recurring price charged every billing period, in `currency`.

sku.description: Stock keeping unit, free text set by the seller (e.g. `TSHIRT-LARGE-BLUE`). Not enforced unique. `null` when unset.

split_pay_required_payments.description: Installment payments required before the subscription pauses. Must be greater than 1. `null` if split pay is not configured.

stock.description: Units available for purchase. `null` unless the actor has the `plan:basic:read` scope on the variant's account.

strike_through_initial_price.description: Original initial price shown with a strikethrough, in `currency`. `null` when no strikethrough is set.

strike_through_renewal_price.description: Original renewal price shown with a strikethrough, in `currency`. `null` when no strikethrough is set.

tax_type.description: How tax is handled for this variant, including whether tax is included in the price, added at checkout, or not configured.

three_ds_level.description: 3D Secure behavior for supported on-session card payments. `mandate_challenge` requires a 3DS challenge before payment processing; `mandate_if_required` mandates a challenge only when the payment processor requires it; `frictionless_if_required` uses the regular frictionless 3DS flow. Payments of $1,000 or more use `mandate_if_required` unless `mandate_challenge` is selected. Risk and authentication recovery requirements can override the preference. `null` inherits the account default.

title.description: Variant display name shown to customers. Maximum 30 characters. A variant created without one defaults to its attribute values joined with ` / `. `null` if no title has been set.

trial_period_days.description: Free trial days before the first renewal charge. `null` if no trial is configured or the user has already used a trial for this variant.

unlimited_stock.description: Whether the variant has unlimited stock. When `true`, the `stock` field is ignored; waitlist variants always report `true`.

updated_at.description: When the variant was last updated, as an ISO 8601 timestamp.

visibility.description: Controls where this variant can be seen. When `hidden`, the variant is reachable only by its direct link.

id.description: Custom field ID, prefixed `field_`.

name.description: Field label shown to customer at checkout.

order.description: Field position on checkout form.

placeholder.description: Placeholder text shown in the empty field. `null` if none is set.

required.description: Whether the customer must complete this field to check out.

account.description: Account that sells this variant; `null` for standalone invoice variants.

adaptive_pricing_enabled.description: Whether adaptive pricing is enabled for this variant. Raw setting — does not check processor compatibility or feature flags.

allow_multiple_quantity.description: Whether more than one unit can be purchased in an order. Renewal variants cannot enable it. When `false`, checkouts, carts, and invoices reject a quantity above 1.

attributes.description: Attribute values that distinguish this variant within its product, as a map of attribute name to value, e.g. `{"color": "Blue", "size": "Large"}`.
