TargetingOption.description: One result from the ad-group targeting-options search. `type` picks the shape: detailed-targeting taxonomy options carry the ad platform's `id`, languages carry an ISO 639 `code`, and locations carry the platform `key` plus geographic context.

value.description: The registration number as the buyer entered it, whitespace removed (`eu_vat` values also drop dots and dashes).

TaxTypes.description: Whether or not the tax is included in a plan's price (or if it hasn't been set up)

account_id.description: The account this membership belongs to, prefixed `biz_`.

authorized_role.description: Custom role assigned to this member, or `null` when the member has a system role.

created_at.description: When the member joined or the invite was sent, as an ISO 8601 timestamp.

direct_reports_count.description: How many team members report directly to this member. `null` for invites.

email.description: The member's email address. For an invite sent to an email with no Whop account yet, the invited address; for accepted members and invites to an existing Whop account, `null` unless the caller holds the `company:authorized_user:email:read` scope.

id.description: Team member ID — `ausr_` for accepted members, `mber_` for members whose role is held on their member record, `ausri_` for pending invites.

is_agent.description: Whether this member is an agent (app-controlled account) rather than a human team member. Always `false` for invites.

reports_to_id.description: The team member this member reports to, prefixed `ausr_`, or `mber_` when that manager's role is held on their member record. `null` when the member reports to the business directly, and for invites.

role.description: The member's role on the account. `custom` means a bespoke dashboard-managed role; the API can read but not grant it.

status.description: `joined` for accepted members, `pending` while the invite is pending.

updated_at.description: When the membership was last updated, as an ISO 8601 timestamp.

user.description: The user behind this team membership. `null` for an invite sent to an email with no Whop account yet.

id.description: Custom role ID, prefixed `aurl_`.

name.description: Custom role name.

account_id.description: The account that owns the trading wallet, prefixed `biz_`. `null` when a user owns it.

amount.description: The USDT0 that a deposit, or an order short of trading balance, sends from the wallet, or the USDC that a withdraw sends back, in native units, as a decimal string. A withdraw of `all` shows what it sent once it finishes. `null` otherwise.

average_price.description: The average fill price of the order, in USD, as a decimal string. `null` when it is not known.

client_order_id.description: The caller's own ID for the trade, unique for the account. `null` when none was sent.

completed_at.description: When the trade ended as completed or failed, as an ISO 8601 timestamp. `null` before that.

created_at.description: When the trade was created, as an ISO 8601 timestamp.

external_order_id.description: ID Whop sends to the exchange with this trade's order, so the exchange's order updates can be matched to the trade. On Hyperliquid, the order's `cloid` reported in `orderUpdates`, a `0x`-prefixed 32-character hex string. Not the caller's `client_order_id`. `null` for a deposit or withdraw.

filled_size.description: The size the order filled, in units of the market, as a decimal string. `null` until it fills.

funds_location.description: Where the money is when the trade did not complete as asked: `wallet`, `trading_account`, or `unknown` while a person checks it. `null` otherwise.

id.description: Trade ID, prefixed `tint_`.

instrument_type.description: `perpetual` or `spot` for an order, `perpetual` for a close. `null` for a deposit or withdraw.

leverage.description: The cross leverage set before an opening perpetual order. `null` for a spot order, close, deposit, withdraw or reduce-only order.

market.description: The market, for example `BTC` for a perpetual or `HYPE/USDC` for spot. `null` for a deposit or withdraw.

metadata.description: Free-form string-to-string annotations stored on the trade.

price.description: The limit price of the order in USD. A market order's price is the mid price moved by `slippage_bps`. `null` for other types.

reduce_only.description: Whether the order can only reduce a position. `null` for other types.

size.description: The order size in units of the market, as a decimal string. `null` for other types.

status.description: `pending` until the trade starts. `processing` while it runs, also while an order that did not fill sends the money it bridged in back to the wallet. `completed` when it did what was asked. `failed` when it did not; `funds_location` says where the money is. `in_review` when the outcome is unknown and a person checks it.

status_detail.description: `partial_fill` when the order filled only part of its size. `null` otherwise.

type.description: `order` places one order from the trading balance. `deposit` bridges USDT0 from the wallet to the trading balance. `withdraw` sends USDC from the trading balance back to the wallet. `close` closes the whole position in one market with a market reduce-only order; when the account is then flat, a `withdraw` trade sends the trading balance back to the wallet.

updated_at.description: When the trade last changed, as an ISO 8601 timestamp.

user_id.description: The user who owns the trading wallet, prefixed `user_`. `null` when an account owns it.

account_id.description: The account that owns this trading account, prefixed `biz_`. `null` when a user owns it.

hyperliquid.description: Hyperliquid-specific state. Present when `provider` is `hyperliquid`, otherwise `null`.

id.description: The Whop wallet ID backing this trading account, prefixed `cwal_`.

provider.description: Trading venue that holds the positions and orders.

user_id.description: The user who owns this trading account, prefixed `user_`. `null` when an account owns it.

all_time.description: Funding paid on this market across the account's history, in USD, or `null` when unavailable.

since_change.description: Funding paid since the position size last changed, in USD, or `null` when unavailable.

since_open.description: Funding paid since the position opened, in USD, or `null` when unavailable.

address.description: Lowercase wallet address that holds the Hyperliquid account.

items.description: Subscriptions for live account updates. Send each `message` unchanged after connecting to `websocket_url`.

websocket_url.description: Hyperliquid WebSocket URL to connect to directly for live updates.

reduce_only.description: Whether the order can only reduce an existing position, or `null` when Hyperliquid omits it.

trigger_price.description: Trigger price in USD for take-profit and stop-loss orders, or `null` for orders without a trigger.

cumulative_funding.description: Funding paid on the position over several windows, in USD.

leverage.description: Margin mode and multiplier for the position.

liquidation_price.description: Estimated liquidation price in USD, or `null` when Hyperliquid reports none.

margin_used.description: Margin allocated to the position, in USD.

return_on_equity.description: Return on equity as a decimal ratio string, such as `0.1` for 10%.

account_value.description: Total account value in USD, including unrealized profit and loss.

total_margin_used.description: Margin allocated across open positions, in USD.

total_position_notional.description: Combined notional value of open positions, in USD.

total_raw_usd.description: Raw USD balance as Hyperliquid reports it, excluding position value.

withdrawable.description: USD that can be withdrawn now without closing positions.

client_order_id.description: Client order ID, prefixed `trdcloid_`, or `null` when the order was placed without one.

created_at.description: When the order was placed, as an ISO 8601 timestamp, or `null` when the provider omits it.

hyperliquid.description: Hyperliquid-specific order details. Present on Hyperliquid orders, otherwise `null`.

id.description: Trading order ID, prefixed `trdord_`.

market.description: Market symbol on the provider, such as `ETH`.

original_size.description: Size when the order was placed, as a decimal string, or `null` when the provider omits it.

provider_order_id.description: The provider's own order ID, as a string.

size.description: Remaining order size as a decimal string.

status_updated_at.description: When the status last changed, as an ISO 8601 timestamp, or `null` when the provider omits it.

time_in_force.description: How long the order stays active. `null` when the provider omits it or reports a policy outside the supported values.

entry_price.description: Average entry price in USD, or `null` when the provider omits it.

hyperliquid.description: Hyperliquid perpetual details. Present on Hyperliquid positions, otherwise `null`.

id.description: Trading position ID, prefixed `trdpos_`. Stable for a market within one trading account.

market.description: Market symbol on the provider, such as `ETH`.

size.description: Absolute position size as a decimal string.

unrealized_pnl.description: Unrealized profit or loss in USD. Negative for a loss.

type.description: `cross` shares margin across positions; `isolated` limits margin to this position.

value.description: Multiplier applied to the position's margin, such as `10` for 10x.

channel.description: The live update stream this subscription opens.

message.description: JSON subscription message to send unchanged over the Hyperliquid WebSocket.

UploadStatuses.description: The upload status of a file

balance.description: The user's balance: personal cash + other holdings + deposits still in flight, plus account balances for accounts they own. Computed only on the self view (retrieved with the reserved id `me`) for callers with balance-read scope; `null` otherwise, or when `include_balance=false`.

balance_history.description: The user's cumulative wallet balance over time (USD `{ t, v }` points plus last/min/max), for the balance chart. Opt in with `include_balance_history=true` when retrieving yourself with the reserved id `me`; populated only for callers with balance-read scope and `null` otherwise. A user with no wallet activity returns an empty series.

items.description: The user's personal holdings, each with its USD value and breakdown, in the same shape as an account's `balances`. Empty when `total_usd` is `null`.

banner.description: The user's profile banner wrapper. `null` when the user has no banner.

bio.example: Ceramic coating specialist. Detailing cars in Austin since 2016.

cards.description: Where the user's personal card application stands. Populated only on the self view (retrieved with the reserved id `me`) for callers with balance-read scope; `null` otherwise, or when the user has never applied for a card.

created_at.description: When the user was created, as an ISO 8601 timestamp

earnings_usd.description: The user's gross USD income over time, including a Partner commission breakdown. Populated only on single-user self reads for callers with balance-read scope; `null` otherwise.

email.description: The user's email address. Populated only on the self view (retrieved with the reserved id `me`) for callers with email-read scope; `null` otherwise, or while the account has no confirmed email yet.

id.description: User ID, prefixed `user_`.

level.description: The user's Whop Levels progress, counted across every account they own. Populated only on the self view (retrieved with the reserved id `me`) for callers with balance-read scope; `null` otherwise, and when none of their accounts are in Whop Levels.

name.description: The user's display name

profile_picture.description: Avatar wrapper; its `url` is always present, using a generated placeholder when the user set no picture.

items.description: The social accounts and websites on the user's public profile. Empty when the user has none.

total_usd.description: Total USD value of the user's personal holdings in `balances`, across those with known exchange rates. Computed only on the self view (retrieved with the reserved id `me`) for callers with balance-read scope; `null` otherwise, when `include_balance=false`, or when the balance source is unavailable.

trading.description: The trading account address and its WebSocket subscriptions. Opt in with `include_trading=true` when retrieving `me`. `null` otherwise, without trading permission, or without an Ethereum wallet.

username.description: The user's unique username

verification.description: Identity verification status for the user's `individual` (KYC) and `business` (KYB) profiles. Each is `null` until created, otherwise a `status` of `not_started`, `pending`, `approved`, or `rejected`.

whop_partner_enabled_at.description: When the user became an enrolled Whop Partner, as an ISO 8601 timestamp. `null` if never enrolled.

whop_partner_onboarded_accounts_count.description: Number of accounts the user referred to Whop as a Whop Partner that have processed more than $1 in volume attributed to the user. Populated only when retrieving a single user who is a Verified Whop Partner; `null` otherwise.

whop_partner_verified_at.description: When the user became a Verified Whop Partner, as an ISO 8601 timestamp. `null` for users who are not Verified Whop Partners, including partners who left the program and suspended users.

items.description: Account balances for accounts the user owns, highest balance first. Excludes accounts with no balance.

businesses_total_usd.description: Combined USD balance across every account the user owns.

items.description: Per-currency fiat cash balances.

cash_usd.description: Fiat cash in USD, including pending, in-transit, and reserve.

items.description: Per-token crypto holdings in the ledger's own wallet.

pending_usd.description: Fiat pending and in-transit balances, plus in-flight treasury deposits, in USD.

total_usd.description: The user's personal balance in USD: cash (available + pending + in-transit + reserve) + other holdings + deposits still in flight. Excludes account balances (see businesses_total_usd).

treasury_pending_usd.description: Balance moves into the user's wallet still in flight, in USD.

balance_usd.description: The account's total balance in USD.

id.description: The account ID, which looks like biz_*************.

name.description: The account's display name.

balance.description: Available balance in the native currency.

currency.description: Lowercase ISO currency code, such as `usd` or `eur`.

in_transit_balance_usd.description: Balance moving to the user's own wallet or card, converted to USD.

price_usd.description: USD price per native currency unit, or `null` when no exchange rate is available.

total_withdrawable_balance.description: Withdrawable amount in the native currency.

items.description: Cumulative balance points over the requested window, oldest first.

last.description: Value of the most recent point, in USD.

max.description: Maximum value across the window, in USD.

min.description: Minimum value across the window, in USD.

v.description: Cumulative wallet balance at this point, in USD.

balance.description: Amount held in native token units, as a decimal string.

breakdown.description: Balance split into available, pending, in-transit, and reserve amounts, as native-unit decimal strings. Transfers between the user's own wallet and card are reported in `in_transit` until they arrive.

name.description: The token's display name.

price_usd.description: USD price per token, or `null` when unknown.

symbol.description: Token display symbol, such as `USDT`, `XAUT`, or `cbBTC`.

url.description: Profile banner image URL.

first_earned_at.description: The first time the user earned gross income, as an ISO 8601 timestamp.

owned_accounts.description: Gross income from accounts the user owns or is owner-authorized on.

partners.description: Partner commissions posted to the user's wallet. Pending Partner payouts are excluded until they post; later reversals do not reduce gross income.

personal.description: Gross income from the user's personal wallet.

total.description: Gross income from the user's personal wallet plus accounts they own or are owner-authorized on.

last_24_hours.description: Gross income in USD over the last 24 hours.

last_30_days.description: Gross income in USD over the last 30 days.

last_7_days.description: Gross income in USD over the last 7 days.

bank_deposit.description: Charged on bank deposits into the user's balance.

payouts.description: Fees on withdrawals, keyed by payout method: `bank_wire`, `same_day_bank`, `next_day_bank`, `rtp`, `crypto`, and `digital_wallet`.

pending_auto_topup.description: Charged when pending, not-yet-settled balance is advanced to fund the user's cards balance.

transfers.description: Charged on transfers from the user's balance to another Whop balance.

user_id.description: The user these fees are charged to, prefixed `user_`.

created_at.description: When the preference was created, as an ISO 8601 timestamp.

id.description: Notification preference ID, prefixed `unpf_`.

level.description: What the user is notified about in this scope: `all` or `nothing`.

scope.description: What the preference applies to. Echo it back to `PATCH /users/me/preferences/notifications` to change this preference.

updated_at.description: When the preference was last changed, as an ISO 8601 timestamp.

bounty_worker_onboarding_dismissed.description: Whether the user has dismissed the first-time bounty worker onboarding. Set to `false` to show it again.

cards_auto_top_up.description: Whether incoming funds, including pending balance, are automatically moved to the user's personal cards balance. `false` when the user has no cards balance.

investigation_enabled.description: Whether investigation mode is enabled for the user. Only meaningful for staff users with investigation access.

terms_accepted.description: Whether the user has accepted Whop's terms and policies. `false` until recorded via `PATCH` with `terms_accepted: true`.

terms_accepted_at.description: When the user most recently accepted Whop's terms and policies, as an ISO 8601 timestamp. `null` until accepted.

url.description: Avatar image URL. Always present — a generated placeholder when the user set no picture.

account_id.description: The account (`biz_`) a business recommendation is for, or `null` for personal recommendations

account_name.description: The account's display name, or `null` for personal recommendations

action.description: The recommendation; new values may be added, so handle unknown actions gracefully

items.description: Capabilities this would unlock, or empty

cta.description: The URL the call-to-action links to

description.description: Supporting copy, or empty
description.example: Let detailing customers split a $249 ceramic coating over four payments.

impact_score.description: Estimated impact from 0-100, or `null` when not ranked

reasoning.description: Why this action was recommended, or `null`
reasoning.example: Ceramic coating is the priciest job on the menu, so financing lifts conversion most.

status.description: Always optional — never blocking

title.description: Headline for the recommendation

url.description: The link's URL.

username.description: The user's handle on the platform, as entered or as reported by the connected account. `null` for links without a handle, such as a personal site.

verified.description: Whether Whop verified that the user owns the account.

website.description: The platform the link points to. `website` is a personal site rather than a social platform.

id.description: User ID, prefixed `user_`.

name.description: Display name.

profile_picture.description: Avatar wrapper; its `url` is always present, using a generated placeholder when the user set no picture.

username.description: Public username.

code.description: Machine-readable reason for this specific refusal, such as `bank_warning_not_acknowledged`. Only present when the error carries one.

message.description: Human-readable error message.
message.example: account_id is required

account.description: Account that sells this variant; `null` for standalone invoice variants.

adaptive_pricing_enabled.description: Whether adaptive pricing is enabled for this variant. Raw setting — does not check processor compatibility or feature flags.

allow_multiple_quantity.description: Whether more than one unit can be purchased in an order. Renewal variants cannot enable it. When `false`, checkouts, carts, and invoices reject a quantity above 1.

attributes.description: Attribute values that distinguish this variant within its product, as a map of attribute name to value, e.g. `{"color": "Blue", "size": "Large"}`. Names are snake_case identifiers and come back in alphabetical order. Every attributed variant on a product carries the same attribute names and a distinct set of values; the product lists the full option set as `variant_attributes`. `null` when the variant has no attributes.

billing_period.description: Number of days between recurring charges, such as 30 for monthly or 365 for annual. `null` for one-time variants.

cancel_discount_intervals.description: How long the cancellation discount lasts: `0` forever, `1` the next payment only, or a number of calendar months from when the customer accepts it. `null` when none is offered or the actor lacks the `plan:basic:read` scope.

cancel_discount_percentage.description: Cancellation discount as a whole-number percentage. `null` when none is offered or the actor lacks the `plan:basic:read` scope.

checkout_styling.description: Variant-level checkout styling (`background_color`, `button_color`, `font_family`, `border_style`); `null` inherits the account default.

collect_tax.description: Whether tax is collected on purchases of this variant, based on the account's tax configuration.

created_at.description: When the variant was created, as an ISO 8601 timestamp.

currency.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 code of the currency every price on this variant is stated in, lowercase: the variant's own currency, or the `presentment_currency` the read asked for when the variant can be converted into it.

items.description: Custom input fields collected on the checkout form.

deletable.description: Whether the variant can be deleted (it has no memberships or waitlist entries). `null` unless the actor has the `plan:basic:read` scope on the variant's account.

description.description: Customer-visible variant description. Maximum 1000 characters. `null` if no description is set.
description.example: Two hand washes a month, interior vacuum, and a quarterly sealant top-up.

effective_payment_method_configuration.description: The configuration governing a checkout for this variant, resolved through every layer (the variant's own and the account's) — the shape a session's `payment_method_configuration` carries. Apply it over the payment method types catalogue for the offerable set. `null` means platform defaults; `payment_method_configuration` stays the variant's own editable override.

expiration_days.description: Access duration in days for expiration-based variants, such as 365 for a one-year pass. `null` for variants without an expiration.

formatted_price.description: Human-readable price for display (currency + interval) in `currency`, e.g. "$10 / month".

id.description: Variant ID, prefixed `plan_`.

image.description: Pricing-tier image (`url`, `blurhash`) shown on the product page; `null` when no image is set.

initial_price.description: Initial purchase price, in `currency`.

initial_price_due.description: Total charged at checkout for one unit, before promo codes and tax: `initial_price` plus the first `renewal_price` for recurring variants, or `initial_price` alone while a free trial applies. The trial does not apply when the viewing user has already used one for this variant. Stated in `currency`.

internal_notes.description: Private notes not shown to customers. `null` unless the actor has the `plan:basic:read` scope on the variant's account.
internal_notes.example: Maintenance tier. Upsell the interior shampoo add-on at renewal.

invoice.description: Invoice this variant was generated for; `null` unless created for an invoice.

member_count.description: Active memberships through this variant. `null` unless the actor has the `plan:basic:read` scope on the variant's account.

metadata.description: Custom key-value pairs stored on the variant. Included in webhook payloads for payment and membership events. Maximum 50 keys, 100 characters per key, 500 characters per value. The reserved keys `custom_cta` and `custom_cta_url`, when set, override the product's checkout call to action for this variant.

offer_cancel_discount.description: Whether a cancellation discount is offered. `null` unless the actor has the `plan:basic:read` scope on the variant's account.

payment_method_configuration.description: Payment method configuration (`enabled`, `disabled`, `include_platform_defaults`); `null` when variant uses default settings.

product.description: Product this variant belongs to; `null` for standalone variants.

purchase_url.description: URL where customers can purchase this variant directly.

renewal_price.description: Recurring price charged every billing period, in `currency`.

sku.description: Stock keeping unit, free text set by the seller (e.g. `TSHIRT-LARGE-BLUE`). Not enforced unique. `null` when unset.

split_pay_required_payments.description: Installment payments required before the subscription pauses. Must be greater than 1. `null` if split pay is not configured.

stock.description: Units available for purchase. `null` unless the actor has the `plan:basic:read` scope on the variant's account.

strike_through_initial_price.description: Original initial price shown with a strikethrough, in `currency`. `null` when no strikethrough is set.

strike_through_renewal_price.description: Original renewal price shown with a strikethrough, in `currency`. `null` when no strikethrough is set.

tax_type.description: How tax is handled for this variant, including whether tax is included in the price, added at checkout, or not configured.

three_ds_level.description: 3D Secure behavior for supported on-session card payments. `mandate_challenge` requires a 3DS challenge before payment processing; `mandate_if_required` mandates a challenge only when the payment processor requires it; `frictionless_if_required` uses the regular frictionless 3DS flow. Payments of $1,000 or more use `mandate_if_required` unless `mandate_challenge` is selected. Risk and authentication recovery requirements can override the preference. `null` inherits the account default.

title.description: Variant display name shown to customers. Maximum 30 characters. A variant created without one defaults to its attribute values joined with ` / `. `null` if no title has been set.

trial_period_days.description: Free trial days before the first renewal charge. `null` if no trial is configured or the user has already used a trial for this variant.

unlimited_stock.description: Whether the variant has unlimited stock. When `true`, the `stock` field is ignored; waitlist variants always report `true`.

updated_at.description: When the variant was last updated, as an ISO 8601 timestamp.

visibility.description: Controls where this variant can be seen. When `hidden`, the variant is reachable only by its direct link.

account.description: Account that sells this variant; `null` for standalone invoice variants.

adaptive_pricing_enabled.description: Whether adaptive pricing is enabled for this variant. Raw setting — does not check processor compatibility or feature flags.

allow_multiple_quantity.description: Whether more than one unit can be purchased in an order. Renewal variants cannot enable it. When `false`, checkouts, carts, and invoices reject a quantity above 1.

attributes.description: Attribute values that distinguish this variant within its product, as a map of attribute name to value, e.g. `{"color": "Blue", "size": "Large"}`. Names are snake_case identifiers and come back in alphabetical order. Every attributed variant on a product carries the same attribute names and a distinct set of values; the product lists the full option set as `variant_attributes`. `null` when the variant has no attributes.

billing_period.description: Number of days between recurring charges, such as 30 for monthly or 365 for annual. `null` for one-time variants.

cancel_discount_intervals.description: How long the cancellation discount lasts: `0` forever, `1` the next payment only, or a number of calendar months from when the customer accepts it. `null` when none is offered or the actor lacks the `plan:basic:read` scope.

cancel_discount_percentage.description: Cancellation discount as a whole-number percentage. `null` when none is offered or the actor lacks the `plan:basic:read` scope.

checkout_styling.description: Variant-level checkout styling (`background_color`, `button_color`, `font_family`, `border_style`); `null` inherits the account default.

created_at.description: When the variant was created, as an ISO 8601 timestamp.

currency.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 code of the currency every price on this variant is stated in, lowercase: the variant's own currency, or the `presentment_currency` the read asked for when the variant can be converted into it.

items.description: Custom input fields collected on the checkout form.

description.description: Customer-visible variant description. Maximum 1000 characters. `null` if no description is set.
description.example: Two hand washes a month, interior vacuum, and a quarterly sealant top-up.

expiration_days.description: Access duration in days for expiration-based variants, such as 365 for a one-year pass. `null` for variants without an expiration.

formatted_price.description: Human-readable price for display (currency + interval) in `currency`, e.g. "$10 / month".

id.description: Variant ID, prefixed `plan_`.

image.description: Pricing-tier image (`url`, `blurhash`) shown on the product page; `null` when no image is set.

initial_price.description: Initial purchase price, in `currency`.

initial_price_due.description: Total charged at checkout for one unit, before promo codes and tax: `initial_price` plus the first `renewal_price` for recurring variants, or `initial_price` alone while a free trial applies. The trial does not apply when the viewing user has already used one for this variant. Stated in `currency`.

internal_notes.description: Private notes not shown to customers. `null` unless the actor has the `plan:basic:read` scope on the variant's account.
internal_notes.example: Maintenance tier. Upsell the interior shampoo add-on at renewal.

invoice.description: Invoice this variant was generated for; `null` unless created for an invoice.

member_count.description: Active memberships through this variant. `null` unless the actor has the `plan:basic:read` scope on the variant's account.

metadata.description: Custom key-value pairs stored on the variant. Included in webhook payloads for payment and membership events. Maximum 50 keys, 100 characters per key, 500 characters per value. The reserved keys `custom_cta` and `custom_cta_url`, when set, override the product's checkout call to action for this variant.

offer_cancel_discount.description: Whether a cancellation discount is offered. `null` unless the actor has the `plan:basic:read` scope on the variant's account.

payment_method_configuration.description: Payment method configuration (`enabled`, `disabled`, `include_platform_defaults`); `null` when variant uses default settings.

product.description: Product this variant belongs to; `null` for standalone variants.

purchase_url.description: URL where customers can purchase this variant directly.

renewal_price.description: Recurring price charged every billing period, in `currency`.

sku.description: Stock keeping unit, free text set by the seller (e.g. `TSHIRT-LARGE-BLUE`). Not enforced unique. `null` when unset.

split_pay_required_payments.description: Installment payments required before the subscription pauses. Must be greater than 1. `null` if split pay is not configured.

stock.description: Units available for purchase. `null` unless the actor has the `plan:basic:read` scope on the variant's account.

strike_through_initial_price.description: Original initial price shown with a strikethrough, in `currency`. `null` when no strikethrough is set.

strike_through_renewal_price.description: Original renewal price shown with a strikethrough, in `currency`. `null` when no strikethrough is set.

api_version.description: The API version used to format payloads sent to this webhook endpoint.

api_version_date.description: The dated API version (Api-Version-Date) that v1 payloads for this endpoint are pinned to: events serialize exactly like a REST read at this version (the native serializer where the resource has one). Null when unpinned — legacy (v2/v5) webhooks, and v1 webhooks on the legacy payload shape.

child_resource_events.description: Whether events are sent for child resources. For example, if the webhook is on an account, enabling this sends events only from its connected accounts.

consecutive_failures.description: Number of consecutive deliveries whose first attempt to this endpoint failed since it last accepted one. Later retries of the same delivery do not increment it. Resets to `0` when a delivery succeeds or the webhook is re-enabled.

created_at.description: When the webhook was created, as an ISO 8601 timestamp.

disabled_at.description: When Whop automatically disabled this webhook, as an ISO 8601 timestamp. `null` unless the webhook was disabled by Whop; a webhook you disabled yourself has `enabled: false` and a `null` `disabled_at`.

disabled_reason.description: Why Whop disabled this webhook. `delivery_failures` means every delivery failed for 3 days straight. `null` when `disabled_at` is `null`.

enabled.description: Whether this webhook endpoint is currently active and receiving events.

items.description: Event types this webhook is subscribed to, in dot form (for example `payment.succeeded`).

failing_since.description: When the current failure streak began, as an ISO 8601 timestamp. Unlike `last_failure_at`, this is set on the streak's first failed attempt, so it shows an endpoint that is failing right now. `null` when the endpoint is healthy.

id.description: Webhook ID, prefixed `hook_`.

last_failure_at.description: When a delivery to this endpoint most recently failed after exhausting retries, as an ISO 8601 timestamp. `null` if no delivery has ever failed.

id.description: Unique identifier for this delivery attempt. Pass it to the replay endpoint to re-send this exact payload.

get.description: Retrieves the account's preferences: a singleton settings document keyed by preference name.

ads_agreement.description: The account's Whop Ads services and payment authorization agreement. While `pending_signature`, campaign launch is blocked; sign by answering `requested_information` via `PATCH /verifications/{id}`.

accepted_at.description: When the agreement was signed, as an ISO 8601 timestamp. `null` until signed.

agreement_version.description: The agreement version signed or awaiting signature, as an ISO date. `null` when no signature is required.

printed_name.description: The signer's printed full name. `null` until signed.

status.description: Where the account's ads services agreement stands.

ads_certifications.description: The account's advertising certifications, one entry per certification type Whop offers. Start an application by setting a type's `status` to `pending_information` via `PATCH`, then answer the fields it requests via `GET`/`PATCH /verifications/{id}`.

approved_countries.description: Countries every approved application of this type covers, as ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 codes. Ads targeting only these countries are exempt from the category's restrictions.

business_name.description: The business name on the latest application.

business_type.description: The kind of business on the latest application. `null` until the account applies.

countries.description: Countries the latest application covers, as ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 codes.

denial_reason.description: Why the latest application was denied. `null` unless `status` is `denied`.

request_id.description: The latest application's request ID, prefixed `inrq_`. `null` until the account applies.

status.description: `not_started` until the account applies; `pending_information` while an application waits for answers; `in_review` once submitted; then `approved` or `denied`.

url.description: The website on the latest application.

ads_payment_methods.description: How the account pays for Whop Ads spend. `primary` is charged first; `backup` covers the charge when the primary fails. `null` until ads billing has been configured.

icon_url.description: Balance owner icon URL, present for `platform_balance` entries.

id.description: The funding source ID: a Whop balance (`ldgr_`) for `platform_balance`, or a payment method (`payt_`) for `card`.

last4.description: Last four digits, present for `card` entries.

title.description: Balance name, present for account `platform_balance` entries (null for a personal balance).

type.description: The funding source kind: a Whop balance or a saved card.

icon_url.description: Balance owner icon URL, present for `platform_balance` entries.

id.description: The funding source ID: a Whop balance (`ldgr_`) for `platform_balance`, or a payment method (`payt_`) for `card`.

last4.description: Last four digits, present for `card` entries.

title.description: Balance name, present for account `platform_balance` entries (null for a personal balance).

type.description: The funding source kind: a Whop balance or a saved card.

ads_reporting_currency.description: Lowercase ISO currency code, such as `usd` or `eur`, used to display ad spend and stats. Defaults to `usd`.

ads_scheduling_timezone.description: IANA timezone (e.g. `America/New_York`) used to interpret campaign start/end times and to bucket reports. Defaults to `America/New_York` until explicitly overridden.

ads_triple_whale_integration.description: The account's Triple Whale integration, which pushes Whop ad spend to Triple Whale's Data-In API so it reports as a `whop` channel. Available to any Triple Whale customer — Shopify, WooCommerce, or a custom checkout — by setting `shop_domain`. Requires the `ad_campaign:create` scope. Once connected, ad click-through URLs Whop serves carry `tw_source=whop` and `tw_adid=<ad id>` query parameters so Triple Whale's pixel attributes conversions back to the originating ad — no destination URL changes are needed.

masked_api_key.description: The leading characters of the stored Data-In API key, followed by asterisks. The full key is never returned. `null` when no key is stored.

shop_domain.description: The shop domain spend is reported for, such as `acme.myshopify.com` or a custom domain for a non-Shopify store. `null` when none is set.

status.description: Where the integration stands. `requires_shop_domain` means no shop domain is configured — set `shop_domain` before spend can be reported.

cards_auto_top_up.description: Whether incoming funds are automatically moved to the account's cards balance. `false` when the account has no cards balance.

cards_notifications.description: Whether Whop Card notifications reach this account's team. `true` by default, including when the account has no cards balance. Set it to `false` to stop every card email and push notification for the account — application status, verification and action-required alerts, card-ready alerts, declines, large charges, and cashback summaries. Cardholder onboarding invitations still send, because they carry the only link an invited cardholder can onboard with. Requesting a card is rejected while notifications are off, since the request reaches nobody. Cards on personal accounts are unaffected.

covers_connected_account_negative_balanc.description: Whether this account covers its connected accounts' negative balances. When a connected account's balance drops below zero (from refunds, disputes, or fees), this account's available balance in the same currency pays it back, up to what is available. Refunds on its connected accounts may also take them negative by up to this account's available balance. `null` when the account has no connected accounts.

customer_tracking.description: The saved customer tracking settings for the hosted tracking page and Element, exactly as saved. `null` until set; tracking is off unless `enabled` is `true`.

dispute_fighter_enabled.description: Whether Whop assembles and files the evidence response when this account's payments are disputed. Off by default; enabling it also opts the account into the success fee charged only on disputes it wins.

economic_intelligence.description: Whether Economic Intelligence is on for the account. It turns off automatically at `economic_intelligence_ends_at`.

economic_intelligence_auto_renew.description: Whether Economic Intelligence renews itself every week, with no end date. Turn it on with the `weekly` offer. Set it to `false` to stop renewing, which keeps Economic Intelligence on until the end of the current week, shown in `economic_intelligence_ends_at`; stopping before the first renewal charges the rest of that week at the `7_days` offer's fee. Set it back to `true` before then to keep renewing at the weekly fee.

patch.description:
Updates the account's preferences. Each top-level key present in the body is replaced as a whole; omitted keys are left untouched.

Required scopes depend on the preferences being updated:

| Preferences | Required scope |
| --- | --- |
| `ads_payment_methods`, `ads_reporting_currency`, `ads_scheduling_timezone`, `ads_triple_whale_integration`, `ads_certifications` | `ad_campaign:create` |
| `cards_auto_top_up`, `cards_notifications`, `covers_connected_account_negative_balances` | `payout:account:update` |
| `dispute_fighter_enabled` | `payment:dispute` |
| `economic_intelligence_duration_key`, `economic_intelligence_auto_renew` | `company:update` |
| `feedback_options`, `customer_tracking` | `company:manage_checkout` |

When updating preferences from multiple rows, all corresponding scopes are required for the account.

status.description: Must be `pending_information`.

ads_certifications.description: Opens an advertising certification application. Keyed by certification type (`prescription_drug_ads`); set the entry's `status` to `pending_information` to start, then answer the requested fields via `PATCH /verifications/{id}`. Only one application per type can be open at a time; every other status is set by Whop's review. Requires the `ad_campaign:create` scope on your API key.

ads_payment_methods.description: How the account pays for Whop Ads spend. Requires `primary`; `backup` is optional and covers the charge when the primary fails. Requires the `ad_campaign:create` scope on your API key. Configuring a `card` requires a user token; account API keys can configure only `platform_balance` sources.

backup.description: Optional second method charged if the primary fails. Any pairing is allowed (two cards, card+balance, balance+card); omit it to run on a single method. Must differ from the primary.

id.description: The funding source ID: a Whop balance (`ldgr_`) for `platform_balance`, or a payment method (`payt_`) for `card`. Optional for `platform_balance` — defaults to the account's default Whop balance. Required for `card`.

The funding source ID: a Whop balance (`ldgr_`) for `platform_balance`, or a payment method (`payt_`) for `card`. Optional for `platform_balance` — defaults to the account's default Whop balance. Required for `card`.

ads_reporting_currency.description: Lowercase ISO currency code, such as `usd` or `eur`, used to display ad spend and stats. Defaults to `usd`. Requires the `ad_campaign:create` scope on your API key.

ads_scheduling_timezone.description: IANA timezone (e.g. `America/New_York`) used to interpret campaign start/end times and to bucket reports. Cannot be cleared once set — pass a new value to change it. Requires the `ad_campaign:create` scope on your API key.

ads_triple_whale_integration.description: Connects or disconnects the Triple Whale integration, or changes the shop it reports to. Requires the `ad_campaign:create` scope on your API key. Connecting requires a `shop_domain` to report spend against.

api_key.description: A Triple Whale Data-In API key with the `Ads: Write` scope, validated against Triple Whale before it is stored. Pass `null` to disconnect. Connecting for the first time backfills the account's existing ad spend. Required unless you are only changing `shop_domain` on an already connected integration, in which case the stored key is reused.

shop_domain.description: The exact shop domain configured in Triple Whale's Settings → Store (for Shopify this is the `.myshopify.com` domain; for a custom sales platform it's whatever domain Triple Whale assigned when the shop was set up there). A leading `https://` and trailing `/` are stripped, and what remains must be a bare hostname with no path or spaces. Validated against Triple Whale — the API key must have access to it — before it is stored. Changing it on a connected integration backfills the account's ad spend onto the new shop. Omit to keep the stored domain; there is no way to clear a stored value, only to overwrite it with a new domain.

cards_auto_top_up.description: Whether incoming funds are automatically moved to the account's cards balance. Requires a cards balance on the account and the `payout:account:update` scope on your API key.

cards_notifications.description: Whether Whop Card notifications reach this account's team. Set it to `false` to stop every card email and push notification for the account — application status, verification and action-required alerts, card-ready alerts, declines, large charges, and cashback summaries. Cardholder onboarding invitations still send, because they carry the only link an invited cardholder can onboard with. Requesting a card is rejected while notifications are off, since the request reaches nobody. Cards on personal accounts are unaffected. Requires a cards balance on the account and the `payout:account:update` scope on your API key.

covers_connected_account_negative_balanc.description: Whether this account covers its connected accounts' negative balances. When a connected account's balance drops below zero (from refunds, disputes, or fees), this account's available balance in the same currency pays it back, up to what is available. Only accounts with connected accounts can set it. Requires the `payout:account:update` scope on your API key.

customer_tracking.description: Customer tracking settings for the hosted tracking page and Element, replaced as a whole: fields left out are saved as unset. Pass null to clear them, which turns tracking off. Tracking is off unless `enabled` is `true`. Requires the `company:manage_checkout` scope on your API key.

accent_color.description: Accent color, as a `#rrggbb` hex color. Unset uses the default.

enabled.description: Turns the public tracking page and guest lookup on. Unset is off.

dispute_fighter_enabled.description: Whether Whop assembles and files the evidence response when this account's payments are disputed. Off by default; enabling it also opts the account into the success fee charged only on disputes it wins. Requires the `payment:dispute` scope on your API key.

economic_intelligence_auto_renew.description: `false` stops renewing: Economic Intelligence stays on until the end of the current week, and stopping before the first renewal charges the rest of that week at the `7_days` offer's fee. `true` keeps it renewing again before then, or turns it on like the `weekly` offer. three_ds_level.description: 3D Secure behavior for supported on-session card payments. `mandate_challenge` requires a 3DS challenge before payment processing; `mandate_if_required` mandates a challenge only when the payment processor requires it; `frictionless_if_required` uses the regular frictionless 3DS flow. Payments of $1,000 or more use `mandate_if_required` unless `mandate_challenge` is selected. Risk and authentication recovery requirements can override the preference. `null` uses the standard checkout flow.

title.description: The display name of the account.

use_logo_as_opengraph_image_fallback.description: Whether the account uses its logo as the fallback Open Graph image.

website.description: The account's business website, as an `http` or `https` URL of at most 255 characters. Also added to the account's `social_links` as a `website` entry. Pass `null` to clear the website; existing social links are left unchanged.

whop_partner_enabled.description: Set to `true` to turn on Whop Partner mode for the account, so its team can refer businesses and the account is paid partner commission on their sales. Recorded once; `false` is rejected.

post.description: Starts an LLC or C-Corp formation for a business account. The application is validated and the response returns a hosted checkout URL; once paid, the filing is submitted. Track progress through the account's [`company_formation`](/api-reference/beta/accounts/retrieve-account) field on Retrieve Account.

business_address.description: Company mailing address. Required unless `use_registered_agent` is `true`.

country.description: Two-letter ISO 3166-1 country code, for example `US`.

line1.description: First line of the street address.

line2.description: Second line of the street address.

state.description: State or region code, for example `CA`.

business_name.description: Legal name for the new company.

business_phone.description: Business phone number in E.164 format, for example `+12125550100`. Required unless `use_registered_agent` is `true`.

entity_suffix.description: Legal entity ending appended to `business_name`. LLC formations accept `LLC`, `L.L.C`, `L.L.C.` or `Limited Liability Company` and default to `LLC`; C-Corp formations accept `Inc`, `Inc.`, `Incorporated`, `Corp.`, `Corporation`, `C Corp`, `C Corporation`, `CCorp` or `Company` and default to `Inc.`. Unrecognized values fall back to the default for the entity type.

entity_type.description: Legal entity type to form. Defaults to `llc`.

expedite_ein.description: Request expedited EIN processing for an additional fee. Available only when no founder supplies an SSN.

formation_state.description: Two-letter code of the US state (or `DC`) to form the company in. We recommend `WY` because Wyoming formations are completed the same day.

founders.description: The company's founders. Exactly one must be marked `is_primary` — the responsible party for the filing.

address.description: Founder's personal address.

country.description: Two-letter ISO 3166-1 country code, for example `US`.

line1.description: First line of the street address.

line2.description: Second line of the street address.

state.description: State or region code, for example `CA`.

date_of_birth.description: Formatted as `YYYY-MM-DD`.

is_primary.description: Marks the responsible party for the filing. Exactly one founder must be primary.

ownership_percentage.description: The founder's ownership share: greater than `0`, at most `100`. Shares across founders must total `100`. Required when `entity_type` is `llc`; ignored for C-Corps.

phone.description: Phone number in E.164 format, for example `+12125550100`.

roles.description: Officer roles held by the member — one member can hold several. Required (at least one role) for every member when `entity_type` is `c_corp`; ignored for LLCs. Across all members every role must be covered; `president`, `secretary` and `treasurer` may each be held by only one member, while `director` may repeat.

ssn.description: The founder's US Social Security Number. Leave empty if the founder is not a US resident. Non-US founders can request expedited EIN processing via the `expedite_ein` option.

share_structure.description: Authorized share structure. Required when `entity_type` is `c_corp`; ignored for LLCs.

number_of_shares.description: Number of shares the company authorizes. Must be greater than `0`.

value.description: Par value per share, in USD. Must be greater than `0`; fractional values like `0.01` are allowed.

use_registered_agent.description: Use the registered agent's address as the company address instead of `business_address`.

checkout_url.description: Hosted checkout URL. Send the buyer here to pay for the formation; the filing is submitted once payment completes.

currency.description: Always `usd`.

total.description: Total due at checkout in USD cents.

post.description: Queues one background retry of the account's failed ads payments across its campaigns, using the account's configured ads payment methods. A queued response does not mean payment succeeded; read each campaign's `delivery_status` and `issues` for the outcome. Successful settlement clears the payment block without changing a configured `active` or `paused` status; a legacy `payment_failed` status becomes `paused`. Returns an error when the account has no failed ads payments, or while a previous retry for the account is queued or running.

post.description: Transfers ownership of the account to another user, identified by user ID or email address. If the recipient already holds the owner role, ownership moves immediately; otherwise they get an invite and ownership moves when they accept. The Whop CLI and MCP can hand off a business their user owns as a partner (`as_partner: true`) with the `partner:handoff` scope; other OAuth apps cannot transfer ownership.

identifier.description: The user to transfer ownership to: a user ID (`user_*`) or an email address. An email address with no Whop account yet is sent an invite to create one.

member_id.description: Your member record on the business this referral is made for, prefixed `mber_`, when your role there is held on your member record. Send this or `authorized_user_id`, not both. Requires `as_partner`.

post.description: Creates an ad campaign in `draft` status for an account. Nothing runs until you launch it by setting `status` to `active` with `PATCH /ad_campaigns/:id`.

account_id.description: The account to create the campaign under. Defaults to the account-scoped key's own account.

bid_type.description: How delivery bids in the ad auction: `minimum_cost` gets the most results for the budget, `average_target` holds an average cost per result, `maximum_target` never bids above a cap. Only for campaigns that own the budget.

budget_amount.description: The campaign's budget in USD, which is what it is stored and billed in. Required when budget_optimization is `ad_campaign` (or send budget_amount_local instead); omit when each ad group sets its own budget.

budget_amount_local.description: The campaign's budget stated in the account's ads reporting currency (`budget_currency` on the response) instead of USD. Converted to USD at the current exchange rate and stored as budget_amount. Provide this or budget_amount, not both.

budget_optimization.description: Which level owns the budget: the whole campaign (`ad_campaign`) or each ad group individually (`ad_group`). Defaults to `ad_group`.

Omit or send `null` for no target.

objective.description: The goal the campaign optimizes toward.

platform.description: The ad network the campaign runs on.

special_ad_categories.description: Regulated categories the campaign falls under. Ads in these categories are subject to extra targeting restrictions.

starts_at.description: When the campaign starts delivering, as an ISO 8601 timestamp. Only for campaigns that own the budget.

post.description: Creates an ad group (ad set) in a campaign.

ad_campaign_id.description: The ad campaign to create the ad group in, prefixed `adcamp_`.

audiences.description: Saved audiences to deliver to or exclude. Can't be combined with demographics.automatic.

bid_type.description: How delivery bids are set in the ad auction. Target-based strategies use `desired_cost_per_result`.

budget_amount.description: This ad group's budget in USD, which is what it is stored and billed in. Omit when the budget is set on the campaign instead.

budget_amount_local.description: This ad group's budget stated in the account's ads reporting currency (`budget_currency` on the response) instead of USD. Converted to USD at the current exchange rate and stored as budget_amount; on an update, an amount equal to the current budget_amount_local keeps the stored USD budget as is. Provide this or budget_amount, not both.

budget_type.description: Whether budget_amount is spent per day (`daily`) or over the ad group's full run (`lifetime`).

conversion_location.description: Where the outcome being optimized for occurs, such as a website visit, social-profile visit, messaging conversation, ad interaction, or lead-form submission. The lead form itself is set on the ad.

delivery_schedule.description: Hours the ad group delivers in each week, keyed by day. Each window runs from `start` to `end` on the hour, with `24:00` for midnight, and a day's windows can't overlap or touch. A day that's empty or left out doesn't deliver. Replaces the whole schedule; `null` delivers at every hour. Some platforms need a lifetime `budget_type` for a schedule, on the ad group or on its campaign when the campaign holds the budget.

friday.description: Windows the ad group delivers in on Friday.

end.description: When delivery stops, as a 24-hour `HH:00` time up to `24:00` for midnight. Later than `start`.

start.description: When delivery starts, as a 24-hour `HH:00` time from `00:00` to `23:00`.

monday.description: Windows the ad group delivers in on Monday.

end.description: When delivery stops, as a 24-hour `HH:00` time up to `24:00` for midnight. Later than `start`.

start.description: When delivery starts, as a 24-hour `HH:00` time from `00:00` to `23:00`.

saturday.description: Windows the ad group delivers in on Saturday.

end.description: When delivery stops, as a 24-hour `HH:00` time up to `24:00` for midnight. Later than `start`.

start.description: When delivery starts, as a 24-hour `HH:00` time from `00:00` to `23:00`.

sunday.description: Windows the ad group delivers in on Sunday.

end.description: When delivery stops, as a 24-hour `HH:00` time up to `24:00` for midnight. Later than `start`.

start.description: When delivery starts, as a 24-hour `HH:00` time from `00:00` to `23:00`.

thursday.description: Windows the ad group delivers in on Thursday.

end.description: When delivery stops, as a 24-hour `HH:00` time up to `24:00` for midnight. Later than `start`.

start.description: When delivery starts, as a 24-hour `HH:00` time from `00:00` to `23:00`.

tuesday.description: Windows the ad group delivers in on Tuesday.

end.description: When delivery stops, as a 24-hour `HH:00` time up to `24:00` for midnight. Later than `start`.

start.description: When delivery starts, as a 24-hour `HH:00` time from `00:00` to `23:00`.

wednesday.description: Windows the ad group delivers in on Wednesday.

end.description: When delivery stops, as a 24-hour `HH:00` time up to `24:00` for midnight. Later than `start`.

start.description: When delivery starts, as a 24-hour `HH:00` time from `00:00` to `23:00`.

desired_cost_per_result.description: Cost per result to aim for (`average_target`) or never exceed (`maximum_target`).

detailed_targeting.description: Interest, behavior, and demographic targeting, using categories from the ad platform's targeting taxonomy. Entries across interests, behaviors, and demographics are OR'd together (anyone matching any entry is reached), matching Ads Manager's detailed-targeting box. At most 100 entries per section. Can't be combined with demographics.automatic, and unavailable to campaigns with special_ad_categories. Send the complete intended state — a section you omit is cleared.

devices.description: Device platforms and operating systems to target.

dynamic_creative.description: Whether the ad platform automatically mixes and matches this ad group's creatives and copy to find the best-performing combinations. Meta has deprecated it and rejects `true`; ad groups already using it keep it, and it can't be changed afterward.

ends_at.description: When the ad group stops delivering, as an ISO 8601 timestamp. Omit to run until paused.

frequency_cap.description: Cap on how often one person sees ads from this ad group. Only available when the ad group optimizes for reach or ThruPlay. Under a campaign budget every ad group must use the same cap, which applies across the whole campaign, and only with the awareness objective (reach or ThruPlay ad groups) or engagement (ThruPlay). Fixed once the campaign launches; `null` clears it before then.

maximum_impressions.description: Most times one person can be shown ads from this ad group within the window.

per_days.description: Length of the rolling window, in days.

keywords.description: Search terms the ad group's ads can show for, and terms they never show for. Only search campaigns take keywords, and each of their ad groups needs at least one before launch. Replaces the stored list; omit to keep it.

match_type.description: How closely a search has to match: `broad` also reaches related searches, `phrase` needs the meaning of the phrase, and `exact` needs the same meaning as the term. Defaults to `broad`.

negative.description: Set to `true` to keep the ads from showing for this term instead. Defaults to `false`.

text.description: The search term, up to 80 characters and 10 words. Symbols such as ! @ % , * = ^ ; ~ | < > ? ( ) { } and quotes aren't allowed: set the match with match_type instead.

languages.description: Languages to target, as ISO 639 codes such as `en` or `es`. Empty or omitted targets all languages.

message_apps.description: Apps the conversation opens in. Required when setting `conversion_location` to `messaging`, and rejected unless the ad group's conversion location is `messaging`.

minimum_daily_spend.description: Minimum the ad group tries to spend each day.

optimization_goal.description: The result the ad group's delivery is optimized to get the most of.

platform.description: Platform the ads run on.

positions.description: Positions to target within the platform, such as `feed` or `story`. Omit to target all of the platform's positions.

placements.description:
`automatic` to let the ad platform choose placements, or the list of platforms and positions to target. Omit a platform's positions to target all of them.

Valid positions per platform:

- `facebook`: `feed`, `right_hand_column`, `marketplace`, `search`, `profile_feed`, `notification`, `story`, `instream_video`, `facebook_reels`, `facebook_reels_overlay`, `biz_disco_feed`

Only allowed when the ad group's conversion_location is an instant-form destination. Mutually exclusive with lead_form. Replaces a stored lead_form.

messaging_config.description: Click-to-message welcome copy: the greeting (message) and the ice-breaker prompt (keyword).

message.example: Hi! Which vehicle are we coating?

multi_advertiser_ads.description: Whether the ad can appear alongside other advertisers' ads in the same unit. Defaults to true.

music.description: The looping track a TikTok carousel ad plays — an MP3 you uploaded, no larger than 10MB. Omitted leaves the ad's music untouched. Null removes it before launch; a submitted carousel takes a replacement track instead. TikTok-only.

id.description: Uploaded MP3 file ID, prefixed `file_`.

post_source.description: Identifies the network that owns `existing_post_id`. The source is inferred from the ID shape when omitted.

primary_texts.description: The primary text shown in the ad body. Entries without a language are the ad's own copy (several make text variations); add one entry per other language on a Meta ad with `translations`.

language.description: ISO 639 code of the language this text is in, such as `es`. Required on every entry of an ad with `translations`, where the ad's own copy uses `translations.source_language`. Leave it out on an ad without translations.

text.example: Book a two-day ceramic coating and keep the shine for three years.

title.description: The display name of the ad.

translations.description: Shows a Meta ad in other languages. Each viewer sees the version for their language; everyone else sees the ad's own copy. Tag every copy and creatives entry with its language: the ad's own with `source_language`, and give every other language a `primary_texts` and `headlines` entry (a `descriptions` entry and a `creatives` entry are optional), or list it in `automatic_languages`. Needs a website destination, one image or video, and exactly one primary text and headline of the ad's own (and at most one description), with no Dynamic Creative or crops. Replaced as a whole when sent, so send `automatic_languages` with `source_language`. null turns translations off and deletes their media. Meta-only.

automatic_languages.description: ISO 639 codes Meta translates the ad's own copy into automatically. English copy translates into `es`, `fr`, `de`, `pt`, `it`, `ar`, `nl`, `ms`, `sv`, `id`, `pl`, `hi`, `da`, `tr`, `fil`, and `ro`; `de`, `ar`, `he`, `es`, `ja`, `no`, `fr`, `nl`, and `sv` copy translate into `en`.

source_language.description: ISO 639 code the ad's own copy is written in, such as `en`.

url.description: The URL the ad links to. Query parameters are merged into url_parameters, so the stored URL is always bare.

url_parameters.description: Query parameters to append to the destination URL, keyed by parameter name. Merged with any query string on `url`. Whop adds its own click-attribution parameters; those are reserved and rejected if you set them. Which keys are reserved depends on the ad's network — Meta: utm_meta_ad_id, utm_meta_adset_id, utm_meta_campaign_id, utm_source, utm_placement, utm_medium, utm_content, utm_adset, utm_whop, wacid, wasid, waid, tw_source, tw_adid; TikTok: waid, wasid, wacid, ad_id, adset_id, campaign_id, utm_source, utm_medium, utm_placement, utm_whop, tw_source, tw_adid.

post.description: Creates a custom audience from a customer list, your account's Whop People data, or engagement with videos, lead forms, Instagram profiles, or Facebook pages, or a lookalike audience that reaches people similar to an existing one. Processing runs asynchronously. A custom audience returns one audience; a lookalike returns the requested similarity bands in `data`.

account_id.description: Account ID, prefixed `biz_`.

auto_refresh.description: Filter audiences only, and set only at creation. `true` (the default) rebuilds membership from the filters twice a day. `false` keeps whoever matched at creation and never rebuilds.

column_mapping.description: CSV audiences only. Maps supported identity fields to CSV column headers. Map at least one of `email` or `phone`.

country.description: CSV header for ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country codes, such as `US`.

email.description: CSV header for email addresses.

ltv.description: CSV header for each customer's lifetime value — a non-negative number, currency symbols allowed. When mapped, Meta creates the audience as value-based, so lookalikes built from it favor people similar to the highest-value customers.

phone.description: CSV header for phone numbers.

count.description: Lookalikes only. Number of lookalike audiences to create (1–6).

engagement.description: Rules for membership based on social engagement. Requires a connected social account with advertising access.

exclude.description: Exclude anyone matching any exclusion rule. Defaults to an empty array. Video audiences do not support exclusions; use a separate audience in ad-group exclusions.

include.description: Match any inclusion rule. Video rules must share a retention window and cannot be combined with other sources.

platform.description: Ad platform that maintains membership.

file_id.description: CSV audiences only. The uploaded customer CSV — a file id (`file_...`) returned by `POST /files`.

filters.description: Filter audiences only. The People filters that define membership, keyed exactly as `GET /people` accepts them — for example `{"os": "iOS", "country": "US"}`. Activity dates `event_from` and `event_to` are inclusive and remain fixed on refresh. Use `event_within_days`, `first_seen_within_days` or `last_seen_within_days` for a rolling window. Source values are canonical source paths (`whop:<campaign>:<group>:<ad>`, `ext:<platform>:...`, `referrer:<domain>`, `direct`), exact or with a trailing `:*` wildcard.

name.description: Audience display name. Required for custom audiences; lookalike names are generated from the source audience.

percentage.description: Lookalikes only. Total similarity reach as a whole percent (1–20), sliced evenly across `count` — must be divisible by `count`. For example, 3 audiences at 6% creates 0–2%, 2–4%, and 4–6% bands.

source_audience_id.description: Lookalikes only. The ready custom audience (`adaud_`) to build from; uploaded and People audiences need at least 100 matched people. Meta validates engagement audience eligibility when creating the lookalike.

source_type.description: Custom audience source. Inferred from `engagement`, then `filters`, otherwise defaults to `csv_upload`. Supply only the fields for the selected source.

201.description: Audience created. Custom creation returns one audience; lookalike creation returns an array in `data`.

delete.description: Deletes an audience so it is no longer available for targeting.

parameters.description: Audience ID, prefixed `adaud_`.
parameters.name: id

patch.description: Renames an audience. For an audience built from People filters that keeps itself up to date, pass `filters` to replace them, which rebuilds membership immediately. Whether an audience auto refreshes is set when it is created.

parameters.description: Audience ID, prefixed `adaud_`.
parameters.name: id

filters.description: Replaces the People filters that define membership. The whole definition is replaced rather than merged, so send every filter you want to keep — a filter you leave out stops applying. Keys and values are the ones `GET /people` accepts, such as an `os` of `iOS` or a `country` of `US`, and at least one filter is required. Date filters must be rolling windows — `first_seen_within_days` or `last_seen_within_days` — so the audience re-anchors every time it rebuilds; fixed dates such as `first_seen_after` are rejected, as is `audience_id`. An array value holds at most 500 items, and each value at most 10 KB. Only an audience with a `source_type` of `people_filter` and `auto_refresh` of `true` accepts filters: an uploaded list has no filters to replace, and with auto refresh off the audience keeps the people it matched when it was built, so create a new audience instead.

name.description: New audience display name. A blank value is ignored rather than clearing the name.

post.description: Creates a bounty and escrows its reward pool. Publishes immediately, or as a scheduled draft when you set `publish_at`.

accepted_submissions_limit.description: Number of submissions that can be accepted (winner slots). Defaults to 1. The escrowed total is `gross_reward_amount` times this limit and must be at least $5.

accepted_submissions_per_user_limit.description: How many winner slots one worker can win. Defaults to `1`. Wins plus proofs awaiting review never exceed this number, and a worker runs one attempt at a time. Cannot exceed `accepted_submissions_limit`.

account_id.description: Account whose balance funds the bounty pool (`biz_` tag). Defaults to the caller's personal balance. Requires permission to move the account's funds.

allowed_country_codes.description: Countries whose residents can work the bounty, as ISO 3166 alpha-2 codes. Empty means worldwide.

embed_camera_metadata.description: Whether the recorder also writes camera make and model into the video container's metadata.

frame_gap_tolerance_ms.description: Longest stall between consecutive frames a clip may contain before the client rejects it, in milliseconds. Unlike the recording fields this one can also be tuned after the bounty is created, since it bounds what is accepted rather than how footage is captured.

min_clip_duration_seconds.description: Minimum length of a single clip, in seconds.

min_total_verified_duration_seconds.description: Total verified footage a submission must accumulate across all its clips before it can be submitted, in seconds. Must be a whole number of hours between 1 and 12. Editable after create, until someone starts an attempt.

stabilization_mode.description: How the recorder configures video stabilization. `off` preserves raw motion for pose extraction.

experience_id.description: Experience to host the bounty in (`exp_` tag). Any visibility — public for an open bounty, private for an invited one. Required unless account_id is set, in which case the bounty anchors in that account's public forum.

frequency.description: How often the schedule creates a new bounty. Each occurrence is a separate bounty. Defaults to `once`; only applies with `publish_at`.

gross_reward_amount.description: Gross bounty-pool amount (USD) escrowed per accepted submission, in whole dollars. Platform fees and affiliate shares are paid from this amount.

publish_at.description: ISO 8601 time to publish the bounty. When set, the bounty is created as a hidden draft and funded + published at this time instead of immediately.

post.description: Creates a future-dated card cashback rule for your direct connected accounts, funded by the authenticated platform account. scoped_account_id.description: Account ID, prefixed `biz_`, of one direct connected account to limit the rule to. Required when both merchant filters are omitted or `null`, in which case the rule matches all eligible transactions for that account. Otherwise, omit or set `null` to designate all direct connected accounts.

post.description: Pays out cashback on demand from the authenticated platform's available USD balance to its direct connected accounts. Covers completed, unpaid card transactions created before the request, each under its latest matching rule, which must be funded by the authenticated platform. Filters combine, and an empty body includes every eligible transaction. Payouts process in the background and amounts are calculated then, so the response confirms queuing, not payment. If a payout fails for insufficient funds, add USD to the platform's balance. Requires `payout:transfer_funds`. Supports `Idempotency-Key`, and overlapping requests cannot pay the same card transaction twice.

post.description: Returns the deposit methods for an account or user, including crypto addresses, bank transfer instructions, and, for a business, a hosted deposit page. Bitcoin deposits are converted to USDT on Plasma in the destination's wallet. Business destinations require no authentication. Pass `payment_method_id` to also charge a business's saved payment method for `amount` in USD and add it to the business's balance; that requires authentication with the `payment:charge` scope. The charge has no fees or taxes and does not count as revenue.

amount.description: Amount to prefill on hosted deposit page. Crypto deposits require a $10 minimum. With `payment_method_id`, the amount in USD to charge, and required.

destination.description: Account ID to fund, `biz_` or `user_`. Any business resolves without authentication; a user account resolves only for that same authenticated user.

metadata.description: Custom metadata to attach to the payment the charge creates. Ignored unless `payment_method_id` is provided.

origin_bic.description: SWIFT/BIC of the bank the funds are sent from, 8 or 11 characters. Fills each bank currency's `swift_bic` with the intermediary bank to route the wire through.

payment_method_id.description: A saved payment method of the business to charge for `amount`, prefixed `payt_`. Save one with Create setup intent and `owner_id` set to the account. Only for a `biz_` destination, and requires authentication with the `payment:charge` scope. A declined charge fails the request with 400.

account_id.description: Account ID of the destination owner.

amount.description: Requested deposit amount.

hosted_url.description: URL of the hosted deposit page. Only present for business destinations.

bank.description: Bank deposit details. Only present when bank deposits are active for the destination account.

currencies.description: Bank transfer currencies available for this deposit.

currency.description: Currency supported by these bank instructions.

deposit_bank_address.example: 2115 Linwood Avenue, Fort Lee, New Jersey 07024

deposit_beneficiary_name.description: Beneficiary name to use for transfer.

deposit_reference.description: Reference to include with bank transfer.

rails.description: Active deposit rails for this currency.

routing_number.description: Bank routing number for deposits in this currency.

swift_bic.description: SWIFT/BIC of the intermediary bank the sending bank routes an international wire through. Null unless `origin_bic` is provided and an intermediary is published for that bank and currency.

card.description: The charge to a saved payment method. Null unless `payment_method_id` was passed.

metadata.description: The custom metadata attached to the payment the charge created. Null if none was passed.

payment_id.description: The payment the charge created, prefixed `pay_`. Retrieve it, or listen for `payment.succeeded`, to confirm the funds landed.

payment_method_id.description: The saved payment method that was charged, prefixed `payt_`.

crypto.description: Crypto networks available for this deposit, each with its on-chain deposit address and the tokens accepted on that network. Crypto deposits require a $10 minimum.

name.description: Network display name.

post.description: Sends a bank deposit back to the bank account that wired it and takes it back out of the balance. Identify the deposit by its `vbt_` ID, the `source.id` of its row in the account's financial activity. The available balance has to cover the deposit minus the deposit fee, which is refunded. Returns the reversal's own row in the financial activity: a `topup_reversal` debit for the full deposit amount, whose `source` is the bank deposit. The source's `status` is `reversal_in_progress` until the money is back with the sender, then `reversed`.

metadata.description: Custom metadata to store with the reversal.

user_id.description: The user that received the deposit, prefixed `user_`. Pass this or `account_id`.

404.description: no bank deposit with that ID on the account

409.description: deposit already reversed or not reversible
